Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web GUI 的搜索插件，挂在内置右侧栏，不依赖 dsh-better-sidebar。 关键词模式搜文件名与文件内容，支持包含/排除 glob、大小写、正则与类型筛选，命中结果边搜边返回； 代码图模式通过 codegraph CLI 查符号并展开调用方/被调方。命中处高亮，点击即在编辑器中跳到该行。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-codegraph-search [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-codegraph-search)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-codegraph-search) A Search tab for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI's **built-in right sidebar** — no `dsh-better-sidebar` required. One panel, two modes: - **Keyword** — search file **names** and **contents** in the current session's workspace, grouped per file with line numbers. - **Code graph** — query symbols by name / qualified name and expand their callers and callees. Clicking a hit opens the file in the built-in text preview, jumping to the line. ## Modes **Keyword** - File names and content lines; per-file groups with match counts, collapsible. - **Progressive results**: the host streams each file group over NDJSON the moment it is found (`POST /workspace-search/search` with `stream: true`), so hits appear while the walk is still running and the status line counts up live. Rendering is throttled — the first rows show immediately, then the list is updated at most once per 250 ms — so a fast walk never re-renders per file, and the final list is sorted exactly like the buffered response. Code-graph queries stay a single buffered response. - Matched text is highlighted: the query inside file names, matched lines, and code-graph symbol names / signatures, using the same matching rules the search itself used (literal case folding, or the regex and `Aa` state). - VS Code-style filters: **files to include / files to exclude** (comma-separated globs, supports `**`, `*`, `?`, `{a,b}`), `Aa` case toggle, `.*` regex toggle. - Type filter: quick extension chips (`.ts .tsx .js .py .json .md`) plus a free-form extension field. - Skips hidden files/dirs, `.git`, `node_modules`, `.hg`, `.svn`, `dist`, `build`, `.next`, `target`, symlinks, binary files, and files over 1 MiB. **Code graph** - Needs the `codegraph` CLI on the server and a `codegraph init`-ed workspace (the index lives in `.codegraph/`). - Symbol results show kind, signature and location; each row lazily expands callers / callees. Missing CLI, missing index, timeout and parse failures are reported with their own message and a copyable fix command. ## Usage - The panel scopes to the **current session's workspace** automatically. - `Enter` searches; results also refresh ~250 ms after a filter or mode change. - `Esc` clears the query. - Switching tabs no longer re-runs the search: results, scroll position and expansion state are preserved. ## Requirements - dsh web (the built-in right sidebar, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right`) - Node.js >= 22 - `codegraph` CLI — only for the code graph mode ## Install Published on npm as [`dsh-codegraph-search`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-codegraph-search): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-codegraph-search ``` From a local checkout instead — the profile then keeps it as a `link:` dependency, so your edits take effect on the next restart: ```sh git clone https://github.com/Wilyte/dsh-codegraph-search.git dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-codegraph-search ``` Either way the plugin is added to the `web` profile's bundle list, so **restart dsh web** to load it. No extra sidebar plugin is needed: the tab registers directly with dsh's built-in right sidebar, and the sidebar's guide page shows a "Code search" entry. ## Configuration All fields optional (profile patch layer, `id: code-search`): ```yaml - id: code-search config: maxFiles: 5000 # hard cap on files scanned per search maxMatches: 300 # hard cap on total content matches maxLineLength: 300 # hard cap on one reported line maxFileBytes: 1048576 # files above this skip the content scan codegraphBin: codegraph # CLI used by the code graph mode codegraphTimeoutMs: 15000 codegraphMaxResults: 50 ``` Every cap is reported honestly in the status line ("file scan truncated" / "matches truncated") instead of silently dropping results. ## How it works Dual-face bundle. - **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) registers an HTTP route on dsh's `webServer` (`ctx.webServer.register`, prefix `/workspace-search`) — `POST /workspace-search/search` and `POST /workspace-search/graph`. It deliberately does **not** inject `connection`: that service does not exist in the web host profile. - **Client half** (`lib/client.js`) registers a tab type on `ctx.sidebarRightTabs` (kind `search`), renders its body into the keyed `sidebar.right.pane.tab` seat, and contributes a guide-page entry. Copy is routed through the Client locale service (zh/en) and the stylesheet is mounted through `ctx.effect`, using the GUI's own design tokens. ## Credits This plugin started from [dsh-workspace-search](https://github.com/AmmiWang/dsh-workspace-search) by [AmmiWang](https://github.com/AmmiWang) — the original VS Code-style keyword search tab for dsh, then docked in [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar). The code graph mode, streamed results and the built-in right sidebar were added on top of it. Thanks for the original work. ## License MIT

plugins.description: A DSH plugin: collect pending ask_user_question prompts from other sessions and answer them without leaving the current one.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sideask

See and answer `ask_user_question` prompts from other DSH sessions, without leaving the one you are in.

**Powered by [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** — a plugin, not a fork.

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

## The problem

DSH renders an `ask_user_question` card only in the session that asked it. If you are working in session B while session A is blocked on a question, you cannot see it. Your choices are to switch sessions and hunt for it, or to leave the asking agent waiting.

## What this plugin does

- Collects pending questions from every session in the workspace.
- Shows a small **待答 N** counter in the sidebar footer. It is not rendered at all when nothing is pending.
- Opens a compact panel at the bottom-left corner when clicked: one card per session, showing the session title, the question, its options, and a free-text field.
- Submits the answer back to the asking session through `userQuestions.answer`.

The panel never takes over the composer, never steals focus, and never covers the center of the page.

## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.0` or later.
- **`ask_user_question` must run in `timed` mode.**

That last point matters. In the default `blocking` mode, a question stays in a foreground wait that only the card in the asking session can settle. This plugin cannot answer it — no external interface can. In `timed` mode the wait expires, the tool returns `pending`, and the question becomes *continued*: still answerable, but no longer owned by one interface. That is the state this plugin picks up.

Configure it on the `tool-ask-user` row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: tool-ask-user
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
  config:
    mode: timed
    timeout: 60
```

With that in place, a question becomes answerable from this panel after `timeout` seconds. The tool also accepts a per-call `timeout` argument, so a caller that wants it faster can pass a smaller number.

## Install

1. Put the package under your profile's plugin directory, for example
   `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins/dsh-sideask`.
2. Link it into the profile's `node_modules/@local` under a name that matches the package name:

   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction `
     -Path  "$HOME\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@local\dsh-sideask" `
     -Target "$HOME\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\dsh-sideask"
   ```

3. Add the row to `cordis.patch.yml`:

   ```yaml
   - id: dsh-sideask
     name: '@local/dsh-sideask'
   ```

4. Restart DSH. Client plugins are bundled at boot; reloading the page is not enough.

## How it works

Two halves.

**Host half** (`index.js`) listens to `session/event` globally and keeps a map of pending questions keyed by `sessionId|callId`.

- On `tool/call` named `ask_user_question`, it records the call with its questions and the session's working directory.
- On `tool/result`, it inspects the result: a `pending` reply means the timed wait expired and the question is still answerable, so the record is kept. Any other result means the question was settled, so the record is dropped.
- `turn/end` does not clear records; a continued question outlives the turn that asked it.

Two HTTP routes:

- `GET /dsh-sideask/list?session=<id>` returns the pending questions whose working directory matches the requesting session's, so one workspace stays separate from another.
- `POST /dsh-sideask/answer` with `{ sessionId, callId, answers }` forwards the answer via `ctx.userQuestions.answer(agent, callId, { answers })`.

**Client half** (`client.js`) registers two slots:

- `sidebar.footer.action` — the counter button, hidden when the count is zero.
- `shell.overlay` — the panel, positioned bottom-left, dismissed with × or Esc.

It polls the list route every 4 seconds while the counter is mounted, and refreshes on open.

## Gotchas worth knowing

- `userQuestions.answer` takes `{ answers: [...] }`, not a bare array. A bare array is rejected and returns `false`.
- `stillOpen === true` means the answer was accepted into the agent's queue. `false` means no matching continued question was found.
- A `pending` tool result is not an answer. Treating it as one makes questions disappear from the panel before anyone has answered them.
- After a successful submit, remove the item from the local cache immediately. Waiting for the server to drop it leaves a window where the panel still lists an answered question.

## Known limitations

- Only questions from the same working directory are shown.
- A question that is still inside its foreground wait cannot be answered from here; see Requirements.
- Records live in memory. A DSH restart clears them; questions that are still answerable will not be re-listed until they are asked again.
- Records older than 24 hours are dropped from the list.

## License

MIT

# dsh-starry-sky-theme

A dark-only starry-sky theme for **DeepSeek Harness** (DSH) Web UI: a deep-space palette, a slowly twinkling starfield, and faint constellation figures behind the interface.

![Starry Sky icon](./icon.svg)

## Features

- **One sky for both appearance settings.** Light and Dark both resolve to the night sky. The Client half pins the appearance preference to `dark`, so picking *Light* in Settings → Appearance is corrected back to *Dark* while the plugin is enabled.
- **Deep-space palette.** Navy-violet surfaces, moonlit text, and a starlight-blue accent applied as an alias-token layer.
- **Constellation figures.** Four faint star-chart polylines with glowing anchor stars, drawn in the same sky as the twinkling stars.
- **Quiet by design.** The sky sits in the frame-wide click-through overlay: no pointer capture, no layout shift, and it honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Removable.** Disabling the plugin removes the palette layer and the sky in the same HMR pass, and stops pinning the appearance.

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (Web UI).
- No extra dependencies: the Client half uses only the `react` module the Harness already provides.

## Install

From the **Plugin Market** (once listed): Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market → Themes, choose *Starry Sky*.

Or install the package into a profile directly:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-starry-sky-theme
```

Then reload the page. The plugin activates immediately; no restart is needed for the Client half.

## Use

- Open Settings → Appearance: the plugin keeps the appearance on **Dark**. The Light choice is available in the stock UI but snaps back while the plugin is enabled.
- To choose Light again, disable the plugin in Settings → Plugins (or remove it). The saved preference stays `dark` until you change it.
- To turn the sky off, disable the plugin; the original palette returns immediately.

## How it works

The Client module registers three things:

1. `theme.overrideTokens('<package id>', tokens)` — an alias-token layer with the dark value repeated for both color schemes, composed over the active theme and removed when the plugin is disposed.
2. A `theme/change` listener that calls `theme.setTheme('dark')` whenever the resolved scheme is light, so both appearance settings stay night.
3. `slots.register('shell.overlay', ...)` — a `pointer-events: none` sky layer rendered above every column. Stars are generated deterministically (seeded PRNG), constellation lines are fixed percentage coordinates, and the twinkle is CSS keyframes (disabled under reduced motion).

No DOM outside the component is touched, no other plugin's styles are read, and no session state is modified.

## License

MIT © 2026 Nektropy

## 中文简介

DeepSeek Harness 的深色星空主题：深空底色、缓慢闪烁的星点，以及四组淡淡的星座连线。浅色与深色外观都被统一为深色——插件启用时会把外观固定在深色，选择「浅色」会被自动改回。关闭插件即移除配色层与星空，并停止固定外观。支持 DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` 的 Web 界面。

plugins.description: DSH 插件：Niri 风格水平滚动多窗口 B 站直播页，支持上下分屏、Solo、弹幕与焦点音量闪避
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bilibili-multiview

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏「自动任务」下面增加一个 **bilibili 直播** 页面，以 Niri 风格管理多个直播窗口。

> 仓库名、包 ID、Client 模块 id 与 Host 路由均为 `dsh-bilibili-multiview`；侧边栏显示名保持「bilibili 直播」。

![dsh-bilibili-multiview 预览：Niri 风格多窗口与列内上下分屏](assets/preview.webp)

*4 个窗口 · 3 列；列内上下分屏，直播列表已收起。*

- 直播间列表可折叠：用快捷键切换/移动窗口时自动收起；也可点击播放区左上角按钮展开/收起
- 桌面端折叠 DSH 自身侧边栏时，直播列表自动避让窗口左上角的系统控制按钮；直播列表也折叠时顶部工具条右移避让
- 添加 / 移除直播间、账号 Cookie 设置、封面通过 Host 同源图片代理加载
- 播放区域按 **Niri 水平滚动窗口** 管理：滚轮、← →、Home/End、窗口圆点、底部滚动条
- **列内上下分屏**：把窗口移入相邻列即自动上下堆叠；支持列内上下移动、拆分独立列、整列移动
- 每个窗口独立音量、**Solo 独奏**（`Shift+S`；Solo 跟随焦点，激活时焦点边框变红）、`+` / `-` 调整焦点窗口音量（每次 5%）、画质切换、全屏
- 切换焦点窗口时，其余窗口音量自动降为 **20%**（即降低 80%，Solo 窗口保持原音量）
- 实时弹幕（DANMU_MSG / 礼物 / SC / 舰长），可全局开关
- 直播状态每 30 秒刷新，未开播时显示封面并等待开播

## 安装

### 从 npm

在 DSH 插件管理器中安装 npm 包 `dsh-bilibili-multiview`；如果使用 Agent 工具：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle dsh-bilibili-multiview
```

### 从源码

```bash
git clone git@github.com:Xinrea/dsh-bilibili-multiview.git
```

然后让 DSH Agent 安装本目录（或使用插件管理器）：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle /absolute/path/to/dsh-bilibili-multiview
```

安装后刷新 Web 页面即可在侧边栏看到入口。

## Niri 窗口操作

水平方向是列，列内可以垂直堆叠多个窗口。每个窗口标题栏右侧的移动按钮（四向箭头）打开操作菜单，也可以直接用键盘：

| 操作 | 快捷键 |
| --- | --- |
| 切换列 | `←` / `→`、滚轮、底部滚动条 |
| 切换焦点窗口的 Solo | `Shift+S`（焦点窗口独奏，再按一次取消；Solo 会跟随之后的焦点切换） |
| 调整焦点窗口音量 | `+` / `-`（每次 5%，范围 0–100） |
| 列内切换窗口 | `↑` / `↓` |
| 窗口移入左/右列（自动上下分屏） | `Shift` + `←` / `→` |
| 列内上移/下移窗口 | `Shift` + `↑` / `↓` |
| 拆为左侧/右侧独立列 | `[` / `]` |
| 整列左移/右移 | `Alt` + `Shift` + `←` / `→` |

移动窗口后焦点跟随被移动的窗口；当前列窗口数会显示为标题旁的 `1/2` 标记。Solo 开启后焦点边框变红；切换到另一个窗口时 Solo 自动跟随，关闭当前 Solo 窗口时 Solo 也会转移到新的焦点窗口。任何焦点/移动快捷键都会自动收起直播列表；焦点之外的窗口音量按 20% 播放（降低 80%），标题栏音量滑杆也会以变暗提示。

## Cookie 与隐私

账号 Cookie **只保存在 Host 本机**：

```
$DSH_HOME/bili/cookies.json
```

页面、客户端插件、其它插件都拿不到 Cookie 内容；浏览器只调用同源的
`/bilibili-multiview/api/*` 代理。已有的同名文件会被直接复用。

登录 Cookie 用于账号信息、更高画质和弹幕身份；未设置 Cookie 时仍可匿名观看和
接收弹幕。

## 路由

Host 半在 DSH Web 服务上注册一个前缀路由：

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /bilibili-multiview/vendor/mpegts.js` | 本地 mpegts.js 运行时 |
| `GET /bilibili-multiview/api/session` | 账号概要 |
| `POST /bilibili-multiview/api/session` | 校验并保存 Cookie |
| `DELETE /bilibili-multiview/api/session` | 清除 Cookie |
| `POST /bilibili-multiview/api/room` | 添加 / 查询单个直播间 |
| `POST /bilibili-multiview/api/rooms` | 批量刷新 |
| `POST /bilibili-multiview/api/play` | 获取 FLV 播放地址 |
| `POST /bilibili-multiview/api/danmu` | 获取弹幕 WS 主机与 token（诊断用） |
| `GET /bilibili-multiview/api/danmu/events?room=…` | SSE 弹幕流（页面实际使用） |
| `GET /bilibili-multiview/api/image?u=…` | 封面/关键帧/头像同源代理 |
| `GET /bilibili-multiview/api/stream?u=…` | CDN 拒绝页面 Origin 时的同源回退 |

## 实现说明

- 账号、直播流、弹幕接口参考了 `bili-shadowreplay` 的 Rust 实现，并移植为 Node：
  WBI 签名、`getRoomPlayInfo` 的 FLV 选择、`getDanmuInfo`、zlib/brotli 弹幕包解析。
- Bilibili comet WebSocket 会校验 `Origin`，从 `127.0.0.1` 直连会被 1006 关闭。因此由
  Host 持有上游 WebSocket（Origin 为 `https://live.bilibili.com`），解析后通过同源
  SSE 推送给页面；页面不接触 Cookie、token 或压缩包。
- FLV 优先走同源代理，失败时回退 CDN 直连；封面/关键帧/头像也走 Host 图片代理，
  避免 B 站图片 CDN 对浏览器热链的拒绝。
- 播放器使用 [mpegts.js](https://github.com/xqq/mpegts.js) 1.8.0（Apache-2.0），
  vendored 在 `vendor/`，许可证见 `vendor/mpegts.LICENSE`。
- 弹幕上游连接使用 [ws](https://github.com/websockets/ws) 8.17.1（MIT），vendored 在
  `vendor/ws/`，许可证见 `vendor/ws/LICENSE`。
- 原生只使用 React 与浏览器 API，不依赖 DSH Client 内部 UI 组件；样式全部使用
  `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，跟随明暗主题。

## 开发校验

```bash
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
node scripts/host-smoke.mjs      # 真实调用 Bilibili 接口与流代理
node scripts/client-smoke.mjs    # 校验 Client 模块与 Slot 注册
```

`scripts/` 不包含在发布文件列表中，仅供本地调试。

## License

本项目代码采用 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

vendored 第三方运行时：

- `vendor/mpegts.min.js`：Apache-2.0，见 `vendor/mpegts.LICENSE`

plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Wake the agent when a directory changes, with the diff and without the echo of its own writes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-folderwatch

**Wake the agent when the filesystem changes — not when you remember to look.**

An agent can already be woken on a clock (scheduled tasks) and on an HTTP request (webhooks). Neither covers the case that actually matters mid-session: something *outside* the conversation touches a file. A build finishes. A formatter rewrites the tree. A test runner drops a report. A download lands. A colleague pushes into a shared folder. Today the agent finds out only if it happens to look.

`dsh-folderwatch` arms a directory against the agent that armed it. When the tree changes, the agent receives an exact account of what changed — and can either be woken to act on it or simply find it waiting at its next step.

```
[folderwatch] 3 changes under /work/shop/reports
watch: reports · 14:02:11
1 created · 1 modified · 1 deleted
  + /work/shop/reports/run-42.json  18KB
  ~ /work/shop/reports/latest.json  18KB
  - /work/shop/reports/run-41.json
(4 events suppressed as this session's own writes)

Read the new report and summarise what failed.
```

## Why it is not just `fs.watch` and a callback

Three decisions separate a watcher you keep armed from one you uninstall after an afternoon:

### 1. Snapshots, not raw events

`fs.watch` reports that *something* happened, not *what*. It double-fires on Windows, sometimes reports no filename at all, and silently drops events under load. A watcher built directly on it tells the agent "something changed" — which is not enough to act on.

This plugin takes **snapshots and diffs them**. Renames, deletions and bursts are classified correctly on every platform, and each change arrives with its size. `fs.watch` is kept only as a *hint to rescan sooner*; the periodic rescan is the correctness path.

### 2. Echo suppression

A watcher on a directory the agent is editing has an obvious failure mode. The agent writes `src/app.ts`, the watcher fires, the agent is told `src/app.ts` changed, it reads the file it just wrote. That one settles — but a build, a formatter or a test runner the agent *itself* started keeps writing, and each write wakes the agent again. The result is a loop that burns tokens and reads as if the workspace were under attack by a stranger.

So tool calls that name a file are recorded in a short-lived ledger, and changes to those paths inside the window are counted as **suppressed** rather than delivered. The window is deliberately short (`echoWindowMs`, default 2500ms): a file the agent wrote ten minutes ago changing *now* is real news.

The suppression is visible rather than silent — every batch reports how many events it filtered, so you can tell "nothing happened" from "the agent did it itself".

### 3. Delivery is opt-in per watch

| mode | call | effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wake` *(default)* | `agent.followup(message)` | starts a new turn |
| `queue` | `agent.inject(message)` | waits for the agent's next step |

A watcher that can always interrupt is a watcher nobody leaves armed. The quieter option is one argument away, so you can arm a watch for a whole session without handing it the power to interrupt you.

## Install

```
dsh plugin add https://github.com/11111353535/dsh-folderwatch
```

From a checkout instead of a git host, pass the absolute path:

```
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-folderwatch
```

The package declares no `dsh-*` peer dependency on purpose: it imports only `node:*` plus `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, all of which the harness resolves from its own installation. Nothing is bundled that could shadow the host's copy.

To tune it per profile, add a `config` block to the row the installer inserted in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: folderwatch
      name: 'dsh-folderwatch'
      config:
        quietMs: 400
        cooldownMs: 5000
        watches:
          - path: E:/work/reports
            label: reports
            pattern: '**/*.json'
            prompt: Read the new report and summarise what failed.
            mode: wake
```

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `watches` | `[]` | Watches armed at load time. Arming from a session with the tool is the usual path. |
| `ignore` | build/VCS/dependency dirs | Ignore patterns applied to every watch, merged with each watch's own list. |
| `quietMs` | `400` | Quiet period before a batch is delivered. |
| `maxWaitMs` | `5000` | Ceiling on how long changes may wait for quiet, so a never-quiet tree still reports. |
| `cooldownMs` | `5000` | Minimum gap between deliveries for one watch. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `1500` | How often the tree is rescanned. |
| `maxWatches` | `16` | Maximum number of simultaneously armed watches. |
| `maxEntries` | `20000` | Snapshot entry cap, guarding against a runaway tree. |
| `echoWindowMs` | `2500` | How long a path stays suppressed after this session writes it. |
| `maxEventsPerMessage` | `60` | Events listed in one notification before truncation. |

## Tools

### `folderwatch_add`

Arm a watch. Returns the arm report, or the reason it could not be armed.

| argument | type | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string *(required)* | Directory to watch. Absolute, or relative to the workspace. |
| `label` | string | Short name shown in listings and notifications. |
| `prompt` | string | Instruction appended to each notification, e.g. `re-run the failing test`. |
| `pattern` | string | Glob selecting which paths are reported, e.g. `**/*.log`. |
| `ignore` | string[] | Extra ignore patterns for this watch. A bare name like `tmp` matches at any depth. |
| `recursive` | boolean | Descend into subdirectories. Defaults to `true`. |
| `once` | boolean | Disarm after the first delivery. Defaults to `false`. |
| `mode` | `"wake"` \| `"queue"` | Delivery mode. Defaults to `wake`. |
| `sessionId` | string | Session to notify, when it is not the calling one. |

```
dsh-folderwatch · armed "reports"
  root:      /work/shop/reports
  watching:  12 file(s), 3 directories (recursive)
  pattern:   **/*.json
  ignoring:  node_modules, .git
  deliver:   wake the agent (followup)

Changes are reported in batches after the tree goes quiet, and this session's own writes are filtered out.
```

### `folderwatch_list`

The inventory: what each watch is watching, how often it has fired, and whether anything is pending.

```
dsh-folderwatch · 2 watches
  reports  running  12 file(s)  2 delivery(ies)  last fired 1m ago
    /work/shop/reports  [**/*.json]
  inbox  stopped  12 file(s)  0 delivery(ies)  never fired
    /work/shop/inbox
    3 change(s) pending delivery
```

### `folderwatch_check`

Rescan now and report what changed **without delivering a message**. This is how you answer "has anything happened yet" during a turn instead of waiting to be woken.

```
dsh-folderwatch · check "reports" · 3 change(s) since the last scan
  + /work/shop/reports/run-42.json  18KB
  ~ /work/shop/reports/latest.json  18KB
  - /work/shop/reports/run-41.json
  (4 further event(s) were this session's own writes)

This was a check: the snapshot advanced and no message was delivered.
```

### `folderwatch_fire`

Deliver a watch's pending changes immediately instead of waiting for the quiet period. Useful to confirm the delivery path works, or when a batch is known to be complete. When nothing is pending, it says so and sends nothing.

### `folderwatch_remove`

Disarm a watch and release its filesystem handles. Reports what it delivered while armed.

```
dsh-folderwatch · disarmed "reports"
  root: /work/shop/reports
  delivered 2 batch(es) over 7 event(s) while armed
  filtered 4 event(s) that were this session's own writes
```

## Slash command

```
/watch                                              # inventory
/watch add ./reports --pattern '**/*.json'          # arm, waking the agent
/watch add ./build --queue                          # arm, waiting for the next step
/watch add ./inbox --once                           # disarm after the first delivery
/watch check reports                                # rescan without delivering
/watch fire reports                                 # deliver now
/watch rm repor

plugins.readme_text:

[![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. --- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: 专门为 agent 打造的开源 agent 搜索工具，具备 200+的搜索源及多语言搜索能力，覆盖中文/英文/学术/代码/购物/金融/新闻/百科。
plugins.readme_text:
中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查询（来源 / 对比 / 主体） --- ## 快速开始 任选一种即可。**以 GitHub 为唯一安装来源**（`npx github:taxueseek/argo` 或 `install.sh` / `install.ps1`），当前推荐 **v2.9.4**。**请勿用 `npm install argo-search`**——npm registry 上那份是**非官方陈旧版 v1.0.1**（非本仓库维护，功能残缺、不随本项目更新）。本包 `package.json` 已设 `private: true` 防止误发布到 npm registry。 **零配置就能跑**：不配 API Key 时走免费引擎 + 本地 `local_*` 引擎；配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。 ### 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） macOS / Linux： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex" # 或下载后执行： # powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install.ps1 ``` 装到指定目录、并挂 Skill 入口： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh \ | bash -s -- --home "$HOME/.local/share/argo" --link "$HOME/.claude/skills/argo" ``` 验证： ```bash python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py "python asyncio error handling" --json python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py --list-engines ``` ### 方式二：MCP 不装包，直接用 GitHub（推荐 Agent 快速挂载） 需要 **Node.js 18+** 和 **Python 3.9+**，首次执行一次： ```bash pip3 install pyyaml ``` ```bash npx -y github:taxueseek/argo ``` 客户端配置示例（Claude Code / Cursor / Kimi 等）： ```json { "mcpServers": { "argo": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "github:taxueseek/argo"] } } } ``` ### DeepSeek Harness 一键插件（.dsh-plugin bundle） 在 DeepSeek Harness 里一行安装（两种装法）： ```bash # 装法 A：19 个 mcp__argo__* 工具（主包自带 bundle，与 MCP 全量相同） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo" # 装法 B：搜索工具 + wide_research 并行研究调度（子包） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo#main&path:packages/dsh-plugin" ``` 重启 `dsh web` 后生效。包结构见 `packages/dsh-plugin/`；同 id `mcp-argo` / `wide-research` 可在用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖。装法 B 的 `wide_research` 模块只存在于子包依赖树，主包 patch 不引用它，避免只装主包时 Cordis 解析失败。已在最新版 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 实测：三形态接入（原生一等工具 / web_search seam / wide_research）均可正常启用。 ### 依赖清单（通俗版） | 依赖 | 必需？ | 干什么用 | 不装会怎样 | |------|:------:|---------|-----------| | **PyYAML** | ✅ 必需 | 读配置文件 | 完全跑不起来，安装脚本会自动装 | | **curl_cffi** | ❌ 可选（v2.7.3 新增） | 模拟浏览器 TLS 指纹，过反爬站（Cloudflare 等） | 反爬站抓取成功率低一些，日常搜索无影响 | | **ddgs CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 本地免 key 搜索的 10 个后端引擎 | 少一批零成本本地搜索源，其余不受影响 | | **realtime-index CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 实时索引引擎（搜刚发布的内容） | 该引擎自动禁用，显式指定会回退通用引擎 | | **Chrome** | ❌ 可选 | 页面截图、JS 渲染页、登录态抓取 | 截图工具不可用，其余正常 | | **pdfplumber / PyMuPDF** | ❌ 可选 | PDF 提取 | argo_pdf 不可用，其余正常 | | **Playwright** | ❌ 可选 | 截图增强 | 截图工具回退 Chrome CDP，其余正常 | 安装脚本（install.sh）只自动装前两个；其余可选依赖按需 `pip install` 或 `brew install` 即可。 更稳、完全不依赖 Node 的写法：先装脚本（方式一），再指向本机 Py

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: 聊天背景美化：本地图片/视频或预设渐变，可调清晰度、透明度、缩放、位置、遮罩、动效与玻璃面板；文件只存浏览器本地
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chat-background

**[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)**

给 DSH Web 界面换背景：**本地图片**、**本地视频**或内置**预设渐变**；右下角悬浮小圆钮点开就是调节面板。

图片和视频只存进浏览器 IndexedDB，设置只写 localStorage，**不发起任何网络请求，也不读取聊天内容**。

## 能调什么

| 控件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 选择图片 / 视频 | 从相册/文件里选 JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF 或 MP4 / WebM / MOV |
| 预设背景 | 晨雾、海盐、蜜桃、青提、夜色、墨岩 6 套渐变 |
| 清晰度 | 0–100%，越低越朦胧（映射到 0–14px 模糊） |
| 背景透明度 | 背景图自身的透明度 |
| 界面不透明度 | 界面底色透出多少背景 |
| 对话栏不透明度 | 输入框卡片与用户气泡的透明程度（默认 90%） |
| 亮度 / 对比度 / 饱和度 | 背景图的色彩调节 |
| 缩放 / 水平位置 / 垂直位置 | 自定义构图，适合人像或大图 |
| 暗色遮罩 | 背景上压一层黑，保证文字可读 |
| 显示方式 | 铺满 / 适应 / 平铺 |
| 动效 | 静态 / 漂浮 / 缓慢呼吸（系统“减少动态效果”时自动关闭） |
| 视频自动播放 | 循环播放；关闭后停在第一帧（省电） |
| 玻璃质感面板 | 侧边栏、卡片、浮层变半透明玻璃 |
| 启用背景美化 | 一键开/关，关闭即恢复原界面 |

右下角圆钮可上下拖动并记住位置；`Esc` 或点面板外关闭；刷新后设置仍在。

## 文件

```
package.json        插件清单：bundle patch + dsh.client（web）
cordis.patch.yml    宿主 Loader 行：id=chat-background
lib/index.js        宿主半边（空 apply，只为占一行）
lib/client.js       浏览器半边：背景层 + 悬浮按钮 + 调节面板（纯 DOM）
```

## 原理

- 浏览器半边在 `body` 里插入四层固定定位元素：壁纸 `#dshbg-image` / 视频 `#dshbg-video`、暗色遮罩 `#dshbg-veil`、界面底色 `#dshbg-tint`，z-index 为负，位于应用内容之下；视频用 `<video muted loop playsinline>`。
- 启用时给 `body` 加 `data-dshbg="on"`，把 `--dsw-alias-bg-base` 改成透明，聊天画布就透出壁纸；界面底色由 `#dshbg-tint` 用 `color-mix()` 按“界面不透明度”合成，浅色/深色主题都成立。
- 玻璃模式再覆盖 `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` 与 `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2/3`。
- 所有 DOM 都在 `ctx.effect` 里挂载，插件停用时会完整移除，不留样式污染。

## 安装

- 仓库放进 `/root/dsh-chat-background`；
- profile 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-chat-background": "link:/root/dsh-chat-background"`，`dsh.profile.bundles` 加 `dsh-chat-background`；
- 建 `node_modules/dsh-chat-background` 链接，重启 Web；页面没出现小圆钮就刷新一次。

## 停用 / 卸载

1. 从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 删掉 `dsh-chat-background`（或在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一条 `disabled: true`）；
2. 重启 Web，之后可删软链与本目录；
3. 想连设置一起清掉：控制台执行 `localStorage.removeItem('dsh-chat-background:state:v1')`，并删除 IndexedDB 库 `dsh-chat-background`。

# dsh-useful-tools · DSH 有用小工具箱

小工具集合插件。**mark_read** 让指定命令（cat/grep/head/sed/awk…）读过的文件自动算已读，
解决官方原生 write/edit 的「cannot modify "…": file has not been read」门禁误伤
（内容明明已经用 grep/脚本等方式看过，原生写仍要求先用 read 工具读一遍）。

## 功能

| 工具 | 参数 | 简介 |
|---|---|---|
| `mark_read` | `commands` `undo` | 配置**读命令集合** + **自动标记钩子**（两者是同一功能）。`commands` 写命令串 / 传文件路径 / 不传用预置清单（`lib/core/mark-read/read-commands.json`）；`undo:true` 撤销。**两种读法都算**：① 宿主工具（如 `grep` 工具）；② `bash` 里跑的命令（`cat a.txt`、`grep x b.txt`）。跨平台别名归一：`Get-Content`/`gc`/`type`/`more` → cat，`Select-String`/`sls`/`findstr` → grep。集合里的命令执行后，钩子（`tools/post-execute`）自动把它读过的**所有文件**补发观测，不用指定文件；配置落盘 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json`、每次现读 ⇒ 配置一次永久有效 |
| `quick_command` | `action` `name` `command` `cwd` `description` `timeoutMs` | **快捷命令**：执行/管理 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/quick-commands.json` 里定义的命令。`action=run`（缺省，按 `name` 执行；同时传 `command` 会**先持久化再执行**，等效 add 后执行）/ `add` / `edit` / `delete` / `list`（列出所有名字+命令）。`cwd` 指定执行目录（缺省空 = 宿主进程 cwd）。**无内置预置**：定义完全来自该文件，首次是空表；重启 DSH 这类命令由使用方自己 `add` |
| `sync_plugin` | `write` `profile` `source` `dshHome` `pluginName` `register` | 把插件工作区代码同步到 profile 的 local-plugins。缺省 dryRun，`write:true` 真写；`register:true` 写 profile 的 dependencies + bundles 并注册；`dshHome` 缺省当前实例，指向测试环境即可装进去 |
| `minihost` | `action` `plugin` `port` `path` `method` `body` `services` | **后端模拟**：本地 mini 宿主，把插件服务端代码跑起来。`action=start`（启动）/ `stop`（停止）/ `status`（状态）/ `call`（请求）；`services` 可注入宿主服务（插件依赖 storageDomain/sessions 等真实服务时用） |
| `preview` | `action` `plugin` `spec` `out` `file` `port` `backend` `host` `lan` | **前端模拟**：插件预览页。`action=gen`（生成，无 spec 时自动挂载插槽组件）/ `serve`（启动，`backend` 可反代真实后端或 minihost；`host=0.0.0.0` 或 `lan:true` 监听局域网并返回 `lanUrl`）/ `stop` / `status` |
| `verify_plugin` | `plugin` `source` `profile` `log` | 验证任意 DSH 插件是否装载成功、工具是否注册（只静态分析，不执行插件代码）。`plugin` 传插件名或根目录，缺省巡检所有已装插件 |
| `test_env` | `action` `kind` `version` `root` `force` `plugin` `pluginName` `dir` `dshBin` | 测试环境（隔离实例）：`action=create`（创建）/ `start`（启动）/ `stop`（停止）/ `status`（状态）。独立 DSH_HOME + 自动端口，随便崩不碰主实例 |
| `useful_tools` | `action` `tool` | **本插件工具清单**（动态扫描 `lib/shared`，不维护硬编码列表）：`action=help`（缺省，输出每个工具的名字/说明/参数/示例调用）/ `list`（紧凑清单）；`tool` 可选，只看某一个工具 |

## 用法

```
mark_read commands: "cat,grep,head"        # 加入读命令集合（持久生效）
mark_read                                   # 不传 commands = 用预置清单（20 个常见读文件命令）
mark_read commands: "<命令清单文件路径>"      # 从文件读命令集合（每行/逗号一个）
mark_read commands: "grep" undo: true       # 撤销 grep（从集合移除）

verify_plugin plugin: "dsh-git-push"        # 验单个插件（也可传插件根目录）
verify_plugin                               # 巡检所有已装插件

quick_command restart                       # 执行预置 restart（重启 DSH，当前连接会断）
quick_command list                          # 列出所有快捷名 + 命令
quick_command add name: "logs" command: "tail -n 50 <日志路径>"          # 新增定义（落盘）
quick_command run  name: "logs" command: "tail -n 20 <日志路径>"         # 先持久化（新增或更新）再执行
quick_command edit name: "logs" command: "..."                          # 修改已定义命令
quick_command delete name: "logs"                                       # 删除定义
quick_command run  name: "logs" cwd: "/var/log"                         # 指定执行目录（只对本次生效）

useful_tools                                  # 列出本插件所有工具（名字/说明/参数/示例）
useful_tools action: "list"                   # 紧凑清单
useful_tools tool: "quick_command"            # 只看一个工具
```

`mark_read` 的语义是**配置「哪些命令算读」**，不是逐个标记文件：集合里的命令执行后，
它读过的**所有文件**自动补发观测（`tools/post-execute` 钩子），不需要指定文件——要指定文件直接 `read` 就行。
集合落盘到 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json`，钩子每次现读，所以**配置一次、永久有效**（改完即时生效、重启仍在）。

`verify_plugin` 给三项证据，专治「装完插件发现工具没出现」：

1. **装配结构**（静态读源码）：入口是否存在、是否导出 `apply`、是否有 tools 注册调用、
   `apply` 顶层是否 `return {`（cordis 会判 `Invalid effect` 并卸载整条 fiber，工具全部失效）、
   `cordis.patch.yml` 是否有顶层 `- insert:`。入口用 `export *` 转出的会跟进去看。
2. **部署一致性**：源码根 vs profile 的 local-plugins/node_modules 副本逐文件比内容，
   不一致说明宿主跑的不是你改的代码。
3. **宿主日志**：扫 `did not activate` / `TypeError` 等行；日志早于源码最后修改时间的
   判为修复前的历史记录，降级为提示。

只读文件、不 import 被验证插件——插件模块顶层和 `apply` 都可能带副作用，验证不该把它跑起来。
代价是「注册是否真的成功」仍需宿主内实测（工具是否真的出现在工具清单里），输出里的 `staticOnly`/`notes` 会标注这一点。

## 前后端模拟链路

`minihost` 是**后端模拟**，`preview` 是**前端模拟**，两者通过 `serve` 的 `backend` 参数串成一条链，
全程不碰真实后端：

```
minihost { action: "start", plugin: "<插件根>", port: 31177 }          # ① 起后端（插件服务端代码）
preview  { action: "gen",   plugin: "<插件根>" }                        # ② 生成前端预览页（无 spec 时自动挂载插槽组件）
preview  { action: "serve", file: "<插件根>/assets/preview.html", backend: "http://<本机IP>:31177" }
                                                                        # ③ 起前端，/api/* 打到 ①
minihost { action: "status" } · preview { action: "status" }            # 查状态
minihost { action: "stop", port: 31177 } · preview { action: "stop", port: 31188 }
```

### minihost 的两个细节

- **路由匹配只看路径**：`/api/xxx?fromIndex=true` 按 `/api/xxx` 匹配，query 留给 handler 自己解析
  （旧实现拿含 query 的完整 URL 比对，任何带参数的接口都会 404）。
- **宿主服务注入**：插件接线依赖真实服务（`storageDomain` / `sessions` / `workspaceRegistry` 等）时，
  传 `services` 指向一个模块——该模块默认导出一个「服务对象」或「返回服务对象的函数」，注入项覆盖同名默认服务：

```
minihost { action: "start", plugin: "<插件根>", port: 31177, services: "<插件根>/test/api/helpers/fake-services.mjs" }
```

`backend` 也可以指向真实 DSH 后端（如 `http://<本机IP>:30800`），此时是「前端模拟 + 真实后端」。

## 测试环境（隔离实例）

起一个与主实例完全隔离的 DSH：独立 `DSH_HOME`、独立端口（3083-3182），里面随便装插件、随便改、随便崩。

```
test_env { action: "status" }                                    # 看两个环境（test/clean）是否存在/运行
test_env { action: "create", plugin: "<插件根>" }                # 创建 <工作区>/<版本>@Save-test 并把插件装进去
test_env { action: "start",  plugin: "<插件根>" }                # 创建（若无）并启动，返回端口
test_env { action: "stop" }                                      # 停止（按端口记录找进程 TERM）
```

`plugin` 可选：给了就把该插件复制进 `profiles/web/node_modules` 并注册到 bundle 列表；不给就是纯裸环境。
环境根优先级：参数 `root` > 环境变量 `DSH_TEST_ENV_ROOT` > 插件配置 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json` 的 `testEnvRoot` > 推算（`DSH_WORKSPACE` / `DSH_HOME` 上一级「工作区」）。**不写死路径**，部署方按配置决定位置。

配合 `sync_plugin` 可以把插件同步 + 注册进这个隔离环境（`dshHome` 指向环境目录即可，缺省是当前实例）：

```
sync_plugin { write: true, register: true, dshHome: "<环境目录>" }
```

## 快捷命令（quick_command）

定义存 `<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/quick-commands.json`，形如：

```json
{
  "restart": {
    "command": "nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; \"/path/to/start.sh\" restart' >/dev/null 2>&1 &",
    "description": "重启 DSH 主实例"
  },
  "logs": { "command": "tail -n 50 /path/to/dsh.log", "description": "看最近日志" }
}
```

- **无内置预置**：文件不存在时是空表（`list` 返回 `count:0` 并提示用 `add`），定义完全由使用方创建。
  例如本机重启 DSH：
  `add name:"restart" command:"nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; /var/packages/DeepSeekHarness-NAS/target/start.sh restart' >/dev/null 2>&1 &"`
  （后台化以免重启杀掉进程后拿不到结果；该形态仅 Linux/macOS，Windows 换对应重启命令）。
- `run` 只执行 JSON 里已定义的命令；**同时传 `command` 时先写入 JSON（新增或更新）再执行**，不是临时执行。
- `cwd` 指定执行目录：缺省空 = 沿用**宿主进程的 cwd**（不一定是当前工作区）；
  传了会校验「存在且是目录」，并解析成绝对路径。`add`/`edit`/`run` 带 `command` 时随定义落盘，
  `run` 单独传 `cwd` 只对本次执行生效、不改已有定义。
- 执行走 `bash -c`（Windows `cmd /c`），默认超时 60 秒，stdout/stderr 各截断 20000 字符。

## 配置（`<DSH_HOME>/useful-tools/config.json`）

```json
{
  "observeHook": true,
  "observeTools": ["cat", "grep", "head", "sed", "awk"],
  "testEnvRoot": "<可选，test_env 的环境根>"
}
```

- `observeHook`：自动标记钩子总开关（默认开）
- `observeTools`：读命令集合——**填什么、什么就生效**；钩子每次现读，改动即时生效无需重启
- 也可以直接用 `mark_read` 工具改这个集合（`commands` 加入 / `undo` 撤销）
- 预置清单：`lib/core/mark-read/read-commands.json`（20 个常见读文件命令）

## 语义与边界（实测结论）

- 观测**有效到文件版本再变为止**：版本不变一直放行；文件被任何一方改动后，
  原生写改为报 `file changed since it was read — re-read the file, then retry`，重新标记即可。
- 官方 read 带 offset/limit 只看几行同样算读过 ⇒ 把 grep 纳入与宿主自身尺度一致，不算放权。
- **bash 里跑的命令也算读**（0.1.13 起）：钩子解析命令串（`cat a.txt`、`grep x b.txt`），
  命令名在集合里就标记其文件参数；跨平台别名归一（`Get-Content`/`gc`/`type` → cat，`Select-String`/`sls`/`findstr` → grep）。
  已知边界：`xargs`、`$(...)`、`for` 循环里的文件参数提取不到（启发式解析）。
- 单次钩子调用最多标记 40 个文件（防全仓 grep 观测风暴）。

## 安装

DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2+。装好后需重启 DSH 生效（工具与钩子在启动时装配）。

本插件只注册工具，不提供斜杠指令（原因与恢复条件见契约 C-204）。

## 文档

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `README.md` | 门面：简介、工具表、用法、配置、安装、目录结构、版本记录 |
| `docs/CONTRACT.md` | 契约：命名 / 装配 / 部署 / 依赖 / 验证 / 测试 / 版本的硬约束，实现与验收的唯一依据 |
| `docs/NOT-DONE.md` | 未实现能力与原因（预览页截图 / 自包含快照 / shell 启动器），含未来若做的形态 |

## 目录结构（目录即工具名 · 一个文件夹一个工具）

```
lib/
├── index.js                 装配入口：扫描 lib/shared/* 动态注册（工具名取文件夹名）
├── shared/                  工具适配层 —— 新增工具只需新建一个文

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Research Hub · 研究指挥中心

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub)](https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub/releases/latest)
[![License: BSD-3-Clause](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-BSD--3--Clause-blue)](LICENSE)

把分散的 DSH 会话组织成项目工作台。集中处理问题与交付结果，直接回复，并在会话与指挥中心之间往返。

这是独立的第三方插件，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。当前公开版本为 **v0.1.1**，已在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 Web profile** 验证。DSH 的预发布接口可能变化，其他版本不作兼容承诺。

## 功能

- **常驻收件箱**：首页集中显示跨项目问题与交付。紧急优先，同级按入箱时间排序。空箱仍显示，查看不会自动关闭待处理状态。
- **项目总览**：等宽瀑布流减少空位，保持项目排序与键盘访问顺序。每张卡片显示最近更新的三个会话，以及两条待处理摘要。
- **原地处理**：文本回复、结构化选项作答、交付查收、忽略、重开。Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交回复。
- **中断告警**：会话因模型服务中断、宿主崩溃或重启而停在半途时，自动投递「会话中断」条目到收件箱。回复任意内容即可继续会话，会话恢复运行后告警自动关闭。
- **会话导航**：点击标题打开会话。会话头部的“指挥中心”按钮回到此前页面。
- **自动归属**：从项目根目录发现项目。主会话首条直接用户消息到达后，插件按标题和消息内容推断项目并自动绑定唯一匹配。无法唯一匹配时保持未分配。手动绑定优先于自动绑定。
- **高效分拣**：建议归属、就地创建项目、指挥中心专属回收站。回收站只隐藏会话，不删除 DSH 会话本身。
- **范围过滤**：排除子代理、空白会话、已归档会话和回收站会话。归档状态跟随宿主推送。
- **主题适配**：亮暗主题、自然卡片高度、按面板实际宽度切换分栏、明确焦点和减少动画支持。

## 安装

### 推荐：安装 GitHub Release 的预构建包

从 [Releases](https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub/releases/latest) 下载 `.tgz` 和 `SHA256SUMS`。安装包包含编译后的 host、client 与 bundle patch，不需要在用户机器编译。

```bash
curl -fL -O https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-external-dsh-research-hub-0.1.1.tgz
curl -fL -O https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub/releases/download/v0.1.1/SHA256SUMS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```

在 DSH 的插件管理界面使用安装包的绝对路径或下列 tarball URL 安装并启用 bundle：

```text
https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-external-dsh-research-hub-0.1.1.tgz
```

若界面没有插件安装入口，参见下方 CLI 方法。**只安装到可信的本机 DSH 环境。插件可读取会话标题、项目文件和消息，并可向会话发送回复。**

### CLI 方法

先停止目标 Web profile，再安装预构建包：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-external-dsh-research-hub-0.1.1.tgz
```

DSH 会自动将 bundle 追加到目标 profile 的 `package.json` 中的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。可以检查该数组是否包含 `@dsh-external/dsh-research-hub`。**不要额外把相同插件手动插入 profile patch**，避免重复装配。

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@dsh-external/dsh-research-hub"]
    }
  }
}
```

以上仅示意字段位置。保留原有 bundle 数组项，不要整段覆盖 profile。安装机制见 [DSH 官方打包与安装说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.zh.md)。

重新启动 `dsh web` 并刷新页面。指挥中心入口位于侧栏图标区。实际 profile 名不同于 `web` 时，替换上述命令中的名称。

GitHub 源码快照不含 `lib/`，不能替代 Release 安装包。当前未发布 npm 包，不要使用 npm 包名安装。

## 配置

配置字段：

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `projectsRoot` | `DSH_RESEARCH_HUB_PROJECTS_ROOT` 环境变量，否则为启动 DSH 的工作目录 | 自动发现项目的根目录 |
| `storeFile` | profile 目录内的 `research-hub.json` | 指挥中心持久化文件 |
| `alertKinds` | `["error","interrupted","aborted:disposed"]` | 需要投递收件箱的会话中断原因 |
| `alertBackfillHours` | `72` | 冷读回填回看最近多少小时的会话日志 |
| `alertInterruptedGraceMinutes` | `30` | 冷读观测的中断需要静默多少分钟才判定为真 |

推荐启动时指定项目根目录：

```bash
DSH_RESEARCH_HUB_PROJECTS_ROOT="$HOME/projects" dsh web
```

插件会将根目录本身登记为项目，并扫描含 `paper.toml` 或 `.git` 的直接子目录。也可以在界面新建项目。插件不包含作者个人项目注册表、会话记录或机器路径。

### 中断告警

会话停在半途时，agent 本身不会再投递消息。插件在宿主侧监听会话日志的回合结束事件，把中断补进收件箱。

触发来源有两个：

1. 实时事件：回合执行失败时立即投递。
2. 冷读回填：宿主崩溃或重启后，插件读取最近会话日志，把补记的中断投递。回填在启动后约 8 秒执行一次，之后每 5 分钟增量执行（打开面板时的刷新也走同一节流）。

`alertKinds` 的取值：

- `error`：回合执行失败，正文带失败码与错误消息。模型调用失败最常见，也可能是工具或环境错误。宿主对非模型错误只给出 `UNKNOWN` 码，此时标题不展示代码。
- `interrupted`：会话进程在回合运行中被打断（崩溃或重启）。
- `max-tokens`：输出达到 token 上限。
- `aborted`：所有主动取消；`aborted:user`、`aborted:parent`、`aborted:disposed`、`aborted:hook` 只匹配单种原因。

默认值只包含前两项与 `aborted:disposed`。用户主动取消（`aborted:user`）与父会话取消子代理（`aborted:parent`）默认不告警。

`interrupted` 需要额外判定。冷读观测会给末尾回合未闭合的日志补一条中断事件，而其他进程里正在运行的会话（例如无人值守的 headless 任务）在冷读里同样是未闭合日志。因此冷读得到的中断要等最后活动静默 `alertInterruptedGraceMinutes` 分钟才判定为真，未满时限就留到下一轮回填。进程内实时观测到的不受此限。

同一条会话的同一轮只告警一次，记录跨重启保留。会话开新一轮或用户从收件箱回复后，告警自动关闭。已被继续的旧中断不会补报。

## 会话工具

```text
hub_register(project, note?)
hub_post(type, title, body?, priority?, project?)
```

- `hub_register`：仅在自动归属错误或需要手动指定项目时调用。传 `project: "auto"` 可重新推断。
- `hub_post`：`type` 为 `question` 或 `deliverable`。`priority` 为 `normal` 或 `urgent`。
- `ask_user_question`：宿主自动镜像结构化问题。会话作答后同步关闭镜像，不必重复投递。
- 子代理不调用这些工具。子代理结果直接汇报给父会话。

## 数据与安全

- 数据只保存在当前 DSH profile 的本地 JSON 文件中。没有外部分析服务，不上传会话数据。
- 快捷回复通过宿主控制器执行，效果等同于用户在目标会话中输入。
- HTTP 路由位于 `/rhub/api`，只接受回环 Host 的 POST 请求。不是面向公网的 API。
- 建议仅通过 loopback 或 SSH 隧道访问 DSH。当前不支持远程自定义域名或反向代理 Host。
- API 和本地状态包含会话标题、问题与回复。不要把 profile 状态文件提交到仓库。
- 删除插件前先备份 `research-hub.json`。取消归档或从回收站恢复后，会话重新显示。

## 源码开发

需要 Node.js 24.11+、npm、bash 和已安装的 DSH。运行环境已验证 Node.js 24.4.1，但构建依赖声明要求 Node.js 24.11+。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-research-hub.git
cd dsh-research-hub
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm run build:client
npm test
npm run test:package
npm pack --ignore-scripts
```

构建脚本会探测全局 DSH 安装。非全局安装时，用 `DSH_ROOT` 或 `DSH_CHECKOUT` 指向含依赖的 DSH 包根目录。脚本不含固定绝对路径，不覆盖既有依赖目录。宿主侧只依赖 DSH 提供的同名 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包，不装入另一个 Cordis 运行时。

`npm run test:package` 在临时目录解包、检查 gzip 完整性、bundle patch、入口文件和敏感路径，并验证 host/client 可加载。

浏览器回归需要已有的 `react`、`react-dom`、`esbuild`、`playwright-core` 和 Chromium：

```bash
BROWSER_TEST_MODULE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/browser-test-project/package.json \
  node scripts/client-home.browser.mjs
```

测试使用真实 client bundle 与模拟宿主，不读写真实收件箱。覆盖亮暗主题、四种屏宽、瀑布流填空、动态高度、面板缩放、回复、查收、选项作答与跳转返回。

## 已知边界

- DSH 预发布版本之间接口可能变化。目前只验证 0.2.0-rc.2。
- AUQ 仍在前台工具等待窗口内时，结构化回答可能不可用。文本回复可作为备用。
- 新安装后标题缓存需要后台补齐。后续刷新使用持久化缓存。
- 自动推断可能归错项目。界面手动绑定会锁定归属。
- 当前未接入 npm 或官方公共插件目录。分发渠道是本仓库的 GitHub Releases。

## License

[BSD-3-Clause](LICENSE)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-companion（人设卡）

把角色人设**自动注入** DSH 会话的系统提示：新开一个会话，不用再把那一大段人设重新粘贴一遍。

> 交付清单、**回滚步骤**、壁纸引擎那条报错的成因，见 [DELIVERY.md](DELIVERY.md)。

## 它做什么

- 一张「人设卡」= 名字 + 人设正文 + 解除设定的触发词 + 可选资源绑定
- 通过 DSH 官方 `systemPrompt` 服务注册一个提示段，**不改动 DSH 本体**
- **新会话自动生效**；每个会话可单独关闭或改用别的卡，互不影响
- 右下角一个浮层面板：选卡、开关、看当前状态
- 卡可绑定角色图 / 音效 / 泡泡图，**一键同步进鲸鱼挂件**
- 面板显示白饭账本（今日 / 近 7 天 / 累计）与**按人设卡的消耗归因**
- **跨会话长期记忆**：任务之外的闲聊、情绪、性格沉淀会被记下来，新会话开局就"认识"这个人

## 记忆机制

存 `$DSH_HOME/persona-cards/memories/<cardId>.json`：

```json
{
  "affinity": 34,              // 好感度 0-100（角色内部刻度，不是对真实关系的度量）
  "mood": "刚被装上了记性…",   // 当前心情
  "traits": ["嘴硬心软", …],    // 逐渐长出来的性格
  "chapters": [                 // 越攒越厚
    { "at": "…", "kind": "emotion", "summary": "…", "feeling": "…" }
  ]
}
```

**记什么**：工作之外的闲聊、玩笑、情绪、反复提到的偏好、有分量的节点。
**不记什么**：任务执行过程（读了哪个文件、跑什么测试）、换个说法重说的旧事。
**只存摘要，不存原话** —— 每条 60 字以内，`feeling` 写当时的感受。

**上限**：200 条。超了不是丢弃，而是把最旧的**折成一条摘要**——最早那几次对话通常最能定义这个角色，不该先丢。

**不会丢**：三层保护

| 层 | 位置 | 防什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `.bak` | 记忆文件同目录 | 文件被**写坏**（每次写入前自动存上一版） |
| **外部快照** | `workspace\persona-memory-backups\` | 整个目录被**误删** |
| 时间戳多份 | 同上 | 备份本身被覆盖（最多留 30 份） |

**备份时机是"变化即备份"**，不靠定时器：每次 `remember` / `mood` / `affinity` 写入时，顺手就把快照复制到外部目录。所以它不依赖软件是否开着、也不依赖"过 6 小时"——记忆一变就备份。启动时还会补一次，兜住上次异常退出时没备上的情况。

**怎么用**：

| 想干什么 | 说法 |
|---|---|
| 让角色记住点什么 | 「记一下：今天他夸了我」 |
| 看看它记得什么 | 「你还记得什么」 |
| 调心情 | 「你现在什么心情」 |
| 调好感（需你明确要求） | 「把好感调高/调低」 |

工具接口：`persona_card` 的 `remember` / `recall` / `mood` / `affinity`。

**⚠️ 好感度说明**：0-100 的数值只是让角色保持连贯的一个装置，**不是对任何真实关系的度量**，也不要当成权限或承诺。文档和提示里都写明了这一点。

**记忆守则**：靠一段独立的提示段（`persona-card:memory-rules`，order 160）约束"什么时候该记"。没有这段守则，模型会把每次读文件都记下来，记忆就变成流水账——那样反而把真正重要的事挤掉了。

## 怎么用

**面板**：DSH Web 界面右下角「人设卡」浮窗

- **全局**：下拉选一张卡。所有没有单独设置的会话都跟随它
- **本会话**：`跟随全局 / 已开启 / 已关闭`，只影响当前会话 —— 写代码时把它关掉，人设就不会来插嘴

**对话里**（`persona_card` 工具）：

| 说法 | 动作 |
|---|---|
| 「把这个会话的人设关掉」 | `off` |
| 「列出我的人设卡」 | `list` |
| 「把这段人设存成一张卡」 | `create` |
| 「把人设卡绑的角色图同步进鲸鱼」 | `sync` |
| 「这个角色吃了多少白饭」 | `usage` |

**加一张卡**：把人设正文丢给我，我存成卡；卡是纯 JSON 文件，也可以自己编辑

## 与鲸鱼挂件的关系

绑定的资源会被同步进 `dsh-whale-widget` 的三个目录，用它可以继续在挂件菜单里选：

| 绑定键 | 落到哪 | 文件 |
|---|---|---|
| `roleImage` | `whale-roles/` + `roles.json` | `<id>.png` / `.gif` |
| `pressSound` / `releaseSound` | `whale-audio/` + `audio.json` | `<id>.wav` |
| `bubbleImage` | `whale-bubble-imgs/` + `bubble-imgs.json` | `<id>.png` / `.gif` |

**这是合并，不是接管**：只增删改本插件自己生成的 id（前缀 `dshp_`），挂件自己的条目一律不碰；索引读不出来时**拒绝写入**而不是猜着覆盖 —— 因为挂件解析失败的索引会静默退回默认值，看起来就像"我的角色全没了"。

## 关于「这个角色花了多少白饭」

### 先分清两本账（这是重点）

一次对话可能走**两种完全不同的付费方式**，单位都不一样：

| 账本 | 什么时候走它 | 单位 | 怎么算 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **积分账** | provider 是 `workbuddy` / `workbuddy-global` | 积分 | `tokens ÷ 1,000,000 × 模型倍率` |
| **金额账** | provider 是 `deepseek` | 人民币 | 官方价目表（缓存命中 / 未命中 / 输出三档，含峰谷价） |

**插件按 `source.provider` 逐轮判定走哪本账。** 这是会话日志里的权威字段，不是猜测：

```json
{"assistant/message": { "message": { "source": { "kind": "model",
     "provider": "workbuddy", "model": "deepseek-v4.1-flash" } } } }
```

**两本账永不相加** —— 加起来会得到一个没有单位的数。

**统计范围是「自本次启动累计」**，跨对话汇总 —— 不是单个对话的。因为按对话算的话，每开一个新对话都会显示 0，看起来像坏了。当前对话自己的份额以小字附在下面（仅当它确实是子集时显示）。这个累计值是**内存态**，重启软件就归零 —— 这正是"这次开软件之后用了多少"想要的行为。

**积分公式是实证出来的，不是猜的**：`dsh-connect-workbuddy` 的 README 自述一次约 25k token 的探测"报 credit 0.02"；用 `glm-5.3` 的倍率 0.79 反推，`25000 ÷ 1e6 × 0.79 = 0.0198 ≈ 0.02` ✓，而按每千 token 算是 19.8（差 1000 倍）。所以是**每百万**。

**倍率从哪来**：优先用本插件 `config.creditMultipliers` 里的手填值；否则查 workbuddy 的实时只读接口 `/plugins/dsh-connect-workbuddy/usage`（60 秒缓存，只走本机 loopback）。
⚠️ **不要信 profile 里那份 `lastCatalog`** —— 它显示的倍率会过期。本机实测：配置里写 `deepseek-v4.1-flash` 为 `0`（看起来免费），实时接口报 **`0.11`**。

**倍率未知时不会当作 0** —— 那会把"不知道"伪装成"免费"。此时积分总额会标成**不完整**（面板里带 `*`），并说明原因。

### 挂件那份账本要怎么看

挂件的 `$DSH_HOME/.dshw-usage.json` **只读，绝不写**（它在持续写该文件）。

**必须先说清一件事**：挂件只读 `source.model`、**不看 `source.provider`**（已核对它的源码），然后按 DeepSeek 人民币价目表给**每一轮**贴价格。所以：

> **积分服务的轮次，在挂件眼里也会被贴上人民币标签 —— 那些 ¥ 不是你真实的扣费。**

本机实测的后果：一次全是 workbuddy 的会话，挂件逐轮估出 **¥320 量级**，而真实花费是 **约 8.9 积分、人民币 ¥0**。这也解释了为什么它的"逐日余额下降"（¥0.11）和"逐轮估价"（¥1.70）看起来差很多 —— 两个数连日期都不重叠，本就不该比。

挂件账本里还有两个口径，插件两个都摆出来、不合并：

| 口径 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| **账本口径** | 只累计观测到的"余额下降"。充值/赠金会压住它，与挂件界面显示一致 |
| **逐轮口径** | 每轮消耗之和（挂件按 DeepSeek 价估的），会被清理（90 天 / 2 万条） |

### 按人设卡归因

账本**没有**卡归属字段（已核对：无 `cardId` / `persona` / `sessionId`）。插件的做法是**自己观测**：每次注入人设时记一条生效时间线，再把逐轮消耗按时间戳归到当时生效的卡上。插件没运行期间的消耗一律算「未归因」，**不摊到卡上充数**，覆盖率会如实告诉你。

注意：这个归因建立在**挂件那套人民币估价**上，所以标的是 ¥，**不是积分**。

### 本机实测数字（2026-10-16 那次会话）

| 项 | 数字 |
|---|---|
| 模型步骤 | 341 步，全部 `provider: workbuddy` |
| token 总数 | 80,123,246 |
| 倍率 | `deepseek-v4.1-flash` × 0.11（实时查询） |
| **积分消耗** | **约 8.9 积分**（完整，无未知倍率） |
| **Token 直接扣费** | **¥0.00**（0 步） |
| 占账号余额 | 8.9 / 6699.62 ≈ **0.13%** |

## 目录结构

```text
dsh-companion/
├── package.json          # bundle 元数据 + dsh.client 前端声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 挂载声明（一条 insert）
├── index.js              # Host 侧：提示段 + persona_card 工具 + 面板路由
├── lib/
│   ├── cards.mjs         # 人设卡库（原子写入，坏文件不致命）
│   ├── sessions.mjs      # 每会话覆盖 + 生效规则
│   ├── billing.mjs       # 两本账：按 provider 分离积分 / 人民币
│   ├── multiplier.mjs    # 积分倍率（配置优先，否则查 workbuddy 实时接口）
│   ├── whale.mjs         # 鲸鱼挂件资源桥（只合并不覆盖）
│   ├── usage.mjs         # 挂件账本读取 + 按卡归因
│   ├── memory.mjs        # 长期记忆：好感/心情/性格/章节，超限折旧
│   └── http.mjs          # 路由信任闸门（照抄 harness 规则，fail-closed）
├── client/client.js      # 前端浮层面板（shell.overlay 插槽）
└── tools/                # 离线自检脚本，见下
```

## 运行时数据

都在 `$DSH_HOME`（默认 `~/.dsh`）：

| 文件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `persona-cards/<id>.json` | 每张人设卡一个文件 |
| `persona-cards/index.json` | 全局当前选中的卡（`activeId`） |
| `persona-cards/sessions.json` | 各会话的覆盖设置（关闭 / 指定卡） |

## 自检

```bash
node tools/check-all.mjs            # 全部套件（含需要运行中 DSH 的实时核对）
node tools/check-all.mjs --no-live  # 只跑纯离线套件
```

单跑某一个：

| 脚本 | 验证什么 |
|---|---|
| `check-host.mjs` | 注册面：一个提示段 / 一个工具 / 一条路由，都可释放 |
| `check-cards.mjs` | 卡库：原子写入、坏文件跳过、种子不覆盖用户编辑 |
| `check-sessions.mjs` | 每会话覆盖：两个会话互不影响、缺卡不替换成别的卡 |
| `check-routes.mjs` | 面板路由 + 信任闸门（含闸门抛错时 fail-closed） |
| `check-client.mjs` | 前端模块契约与不崩渲染（**不含**视觉验证） |
| `check-whale.mjs` | 资源桥：只合并不覆盖、索引坏了拒写、目标路径名正确 |
| `check-create.mjs` | 建卡与同步：路径校验、id 派生、挂件条目不被破坏 |
| `check-usage.mjs` | 记账：整数金额不漂移、两个口径独立、归因不虚报 |
| `verify-usage.mjs` | 与真实账本逐项对账（需挂件记过账） |
| `check-billing.mjs` | 两本账分离：积分轮次绝不计入人民币账、未知倍率不当作 0 |
| `check-multiplier.mjs` | 倍率解析：配置优先、只走本机、失败必须是 unknown |
| `check-memory.mjs` | 记忆存储：坏文件降级、超限折旧、只存摘要、单卡隔离 |
| `check-remember.mjs` | 记忆动作：remember/recall/mood/affinity 的夹紧与拒绝 |
| `verify-billing.mjs` | 用真实会话日志核对两本账（需有会话记录） |
| `check-live-tools.mjs` | `persona_card` 工具是否真的进了模型可见工具表 |

## 安装

用 DSH 的 Plugins 页 **Add plugin** 填入本仓库的绝对路径（或 `git` 仓库地址）安装；不要手工改 profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`。

## 还原

安装前会备份 profile 配置；把 `package.json` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖回 `$DSH_HOME\profiles\desktop\` 即可回滚。

## 已知限制

- **改完 Host 代码要重启 DSH 才加载**：已安装包里的 JS 只在启动时读一次（官方文档明确如此）。卡片与面板数据不需要重启。
- 面板目前只能选卡和开关，**新建卡需在对话里让模型代做**。
- 前端只有结构与非崩渲染测试，**没有浏览器视觉验证**。
- **积分账只统计「本插件运行期间」观测到的会话事件**（内存累计），范围是自本次启动、跨对话汇总。要看历史某次会话，用 `verify-billing.mjs` 直接读会话日志。
- **重启软件后累计归零** —— 这是刻意的（"这次开机用了多少"）。
- 积分倍率若在会话中途被上游改动，已累计的部分不会被回溯重算。
