plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lark-cli

[English](README-en.md) | 简体中文

一句话介绍：**让 AI 助手直接替你操作飞书**——发消息、写文档、查日程、管任务、理表格，不用离开对话窗口。

<video src="docs/assets/demo.mp4" controls muted width="100%"></video>
*Demo：在 dsh 会话里说一句话，51 秒后飞书云文档里真的出现了这篇文档。*

| 在对话里说 | 飞书里的真实结果 |
|---|---|
| ![在 dsh 会话中一句话写入飞书知识库](docs/assets/demo-chat.png) | ![飞书知识库文档写入成功](docs/assets/demo-result.png) |

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）提供飞书 / Lark 访问能力的插件。安装后，你可以在会话里用自然语言下达指令，模型通过 `lark_cli` 工具调用官方 `lark-cli` 完成实际操作：

| 你说 | 模型做 |
|---|---|
| 「把会议纪要发到产品群」 | `lark-im` 发送消息到指定群 |
| 「按这份材料写篇 PRD 存到云文档」 | `lark-doc` 创建文档并写入 |
| 「我下周有什么会」 | `lark-calendar` 查询日程 |
| 「把这张表里的待办整理成任务」 | `lark-sheets` 读数据 → `lark-task` 建任务 |
| 「给知识库补一页 xx 说明」 | `lark-wiki` 建节点 → `lark-doc` 写内容 |

设计原则：**官方 `lark-cli` 负责执行 + 技能负责教模型怎么用**，执行与知识分离。

- **一个工具**：`lark_cli`，参数是 `argv`（命令切词，不含开头的 `lark-cli`）与可选 `stdin`。不经 shell，无引号/转义/注入问题。
- **九个技能**：`lark-shared`、`lark-doc`、`lark-im`、`lark-calendar`、`lark-task`、`lark-drive`、`lark-sheets`、`lark-base`、`lark-wiki`，随插件分发，模型按需加载。
- **零凭据配置**：登录态与密钥都由 `lark-cli` 自己管（`~/.lark-cli/config.json` + 系统 keychain），插件不存、不转发任何 token。

## 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| dsh 兼容版本 | [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）**≥ 0.2.0-rc.2**（实际验证版本；需支持 `defineTool` / `ctx.subprocess` / `ctx.skills.registerProvider` 插件 API 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` bundle 机制） |
| 操作系统 | **Windows 10/11**（主要验证平台，内置 `.cmd` shim → `.exe` 自动探测）；**macOS / Linux** 理论可用（`lark-cli` 本身跨平台），未逐一验证 |
| Node.js | ≥ 22.0.0 |
| lark-cli | ≥ 1.0.96（`npm install -g @larksuite/cli`） |
| 网络 | 可访问飞书 OpenAPI 与 `open.feishu.cn` |

## 前置条件

1. 已安装 `lark-cli` ≥ 1.0.96：`npm install -g @larksuite/cli`。
2. 已完成 CLI 侧配置与登录（两条命令都在终端里手动跑一次）：
   - `lark-cli config init`（首次使用，配置应用）
   - `lark-cli auth login` / `lark-cli auth status`（确认身份）

插件本身不做登录，也不会替你保存 appId / appSecret。

## 安装

**推荐用 dsh 自带的插件管理命令安装**：它会自动完成依赖登记、`dsh.profile.bundles` 注册、`cordis.yml` 配置合并——三步接线全自动。以下命令在任何目录执行都可以（`--profile` 已指明目标 profile，示例为 `web`）。

> 本包不含预构建产物（`dist/` 由 tsc 从源码生成），所以 tarball / git 来源安装后需要到插件目录执行一次 `npm install && npm run build`；link 来源在挂载前就要完成本地构建。

### 方式一：Release tarball 安装（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/aminuoshi-378/dsh-lark/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0.tar.gz
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-lark-cli
npm install && npm run build
```

把 `v0.1.0` 换成目标版本号；各版本地址见 [Releases](https://github.com/aminuoshi-378/dsh-lark/releases) 页。

### 方式二：git 仓库安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lark-cli@github:aminuoshi-378/dsh-lark#v0.1.0
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-lark-cli
npm install && npm run build
```

`#` 后可写 tag（`#v0.1.0`，锁定版本，推荐）或分支（`#main`，跟踪最新）。

### 方式三：本地源码 link 安装

适合需要修改技能或源码的场景：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aminuoshi-378/dsh-lark.git dsh-lark-cli
cd dsh-lark-cli
npm install && npm run build

dsh plugin --profile web add "link:<你的克隆目录>"   # 例如 link:D:/dev/dsh-lark
```

本地改动即时生效（重启 `dsh web` 后），无需重新发布。

### 方式四：Prompt 安装（让 AI 会话代为执行）

把下面这段话发给 dsh 会话里的模型：

```text
请帮我安装 dsh-lark-cli 插件：
1. 执行 dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/aminuoshi-378/dsh-lark/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0.tar.gz
2. 在 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-lark-cli 里执行 npm install && npm run build；
3. 重启 dsh web 后执行 dsh --profile web --dump-config 验证出现 lark-cli 条目。
```

模型会调用它的 shell 工具逐步执行。

### 验证安装成功

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep lark-cli   # 能看到 lark-cli 条目
```

重启 `dsh web` 后，启动日志无 `did not activate` 告警，会话里就能用 `lark_cli` 工具和九个 `lark-*` 技能了。

回滚：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-lark-cli`（bundles 会同步清理），再删掉 cordis.patch.yml 里对应的 id 行并重启。

## 升级到新版本

发布新版本时，按你当初的安装方式更新即可；`cordis.patch.yml` 注册无需改动，更新后重启 `dsh web` 生效。

**方式一（tarball）**：把地址里的版本号换成新的重新 add。

**方式二（git 仓库）**：把 tag 换成新的重新 add（或临时用 `#main` 跟踪最新）。

**方式三（link 源码）**：进入克隆目录 `git pull && npm install && npm run build`，重启 `dsh web`。

方式四的升级把对应命令发给模型代执行即可。**查看当前版本**：看 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` 里 `dsh-lark-cli` 的依赖描述，或 `node_modules/dsh-lark-cli/package.json` 的 `version` 字段；新版本说明见 [Releases](https://github.com/aminuoshi-378/dsh-lark/releases) 页。升级后建议在插件目录跑一次 `npm test` 确认环境正常。

## 技能清单

插件随包分发九个技能，模型按当前任务自动加载对应技能；每个技能目录下还有 `references/` 细分文档（按相对路径按需读取），覆盖更细的命令语法与场景 playbook。

### `lark-shared` — 公共规则与认证（必读基础）

所有飞书操作的公共底座：身份选择（`--as user` / `--as bot` 的判定规则）、认证与登录状态排查、JSON 输出契约解析、高风险写操作确认门禁，以及最关键的「**在 dsh 中执行**」规则——本环境不经 shell 跑命令，所有 `lark-cli` 命令一律拆词成 `lark_cli` 工具的 `argv` 调用（管道、`&&`、重定向如何改写，`--jq` 筛选怎么用都在这一节）。首次使用任何 lark 技能前模型都会先读本技能。

### `lark-doc` — 云文档 / Docx

云文档的创建、读取、更新（含 XML 块级结构）、Markdown 双向转换、历史版本；插入与下载图片附件；思维笔记读写；白板；十余种文体的写作流派模板（PRD、周报、会议纪要、小红书、公文、研究报告等，见 `references/genres/`）；还有「创建后自动跑 workflow」的组合用法。

### `lark-im` — 即时通讯

单聊与群聊消息的收发、回复、编辑、撤回语义；按关键词搜索消息与群；群成员、群设置、话题群管理；交互卡片（Card 2.0 全量组件 schema：按钮、表单、图表、列容器、图片等）；表情回复；消息加急（应用内 / 短信 / 电话）；Feed 置顶与标签管理。

### `lark-calendar` — 日历

日程创建 / 更新 / 取消（含重复日程 RRULE）、全天与模糊时间表达、参会人管理与 RSVP 回执、忙闲查询与时段推荐、会议室查找与预定、跨日历日程转移、日程与会议（视频会议）关联。

### `lark-task` — 任务待办

任务创建 / 更新 / 完成 / 重开、子任务拆解与祖先设置、清单（tasklist）增删与成员管理、任务搜索与关联查询、协作成员与关注者、提醒与附件上传、任务智能体注册注销及其主页数据维护。

### `lark-drive` — 云空间

云盘文件的浏览 / 搜索 / 移动 / 复制 / 删除、上传与下载（含导出为 docx/sheet 等格式）、文件夹管理、快捷方式、版本历史；评论与回复（含表情回应）；权限管理（成员增删、设置查询、权限申请）；密级标签；另含多个多步工作流 playbook：知识库归集整理、专题迁移收集器、权限治理。

### `lark-sheets` — 电子表格

工作表与行列结构操作（增删、合并、冻结、分组、隐藏）、单元格读写（值 / 公式 / 样式 / 批注 / 单元格图片）、区域复制移动与排序、数据透视表、条件格式、下拉列表、图表与迷你图、浮动图片、公式校验；Excel / CSV 的导入导出。

### `lark-base` — 多维表格（Bitable）

数据表与字段管理、记录增删改查与批量操作、视图管理、分组 / 筛选 / 排序、公式与 lookup 字段、表单视图、仪表盘、自动化 workflow（含 AI 生成文本 action）、字段扩展（field extension）批量写、角色权限、模板；AppMode（Base 应用）页面与组件；`.base` 文件导入导出。

### `lark-wiki` — 知识库

知识空间列表、节点树浏览与检索、节点创建 / 移动 / 复制 / 删除、空间成员管理；以及「wiki URL → 底层对象 token」的路由规则（打开 `/wiki/` 链接时先解包成 docx/sheet/bitable 再路由到对应技能）。

> 技能目录同时通过 `resourceBase` 暴露给模型，正文里的 `references/...` 可按相对路径读取。

## 测试

```bash
npm test              # 纯函数 + 技能快照 + 注册行为（无网络、无 CLI）
npm run test:tool     # 真实 spawn lark-cli：auth status / calendar +agenda / 错误分类 / argv 防御
npm run test:live     # 只读探活：解析路径、--version、auth status
```

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 免费网页搜索与抓取插件：360/Bing 多引擎并行竞速 + 相关性闸门 + GitHub 镜像回退，零费用零 API Key，中文查询与外国网站(github)检索均可用 / Free multi-engine web search & fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-free-web（免编译・免命令行・自动接管版）

这是一个专为 **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)** 打包好的本地预编译插件（已包含编译好的 `dist/index.js` 和自动覆盖配置 `cordis.patch.yml`）。

## ✨ 核心特性
1. **彻底免编译、零依赖**：已完成构建，无需运行 `npm install` 或 `npm run build`。
2. **开机自动接管，告别命令行环境变量**：
   - 内置 `cordis.patch.yml` Bundle 补丁与运行时自动接管逻辑。
   - 安装一次后，自动禁用官方计费的 `deepseek-official` 搜索，永久将 `searchProvider` 设为 `free-search-pfw`、将 `fetchProvider` 设为 `free-fetch-pfw`。
   - provider id 带 `-pfw` 独占后缀，可与环境里其他免费 web 插件（同样注册 `free-search`/`free-fetch`）共存，不会触发 `WEB_DUPLICATE_PROVIDER`。
3. **多引擎并行竞速搜索（`free-search-pfw`）**：
   - **360 搜索**：中文查询精度最高，作为中文首选。
   - **Bing**：英文/全球查询首选（`www.bing.com` + `setlang=en`），能命中 github、官方文档等原始资料。
   - **DuckDuckGo**：兜底，本机常被限流故默认最后。
   - **按查询语言自动调整引擎优先级**，并互为兜底：中文查 360、英文查 Bing，任一失败自动换另一个。
   - **并行竞速 + 提前返回**：多个引擎同时发起，拿到优质结果立即返回，不被慢引擎拖累。
   - **相关性闸门**：搜索引擎偶尔会对某些 IP 返回「串号」结果（HTTP 200、结构正常，内容却与查询完全无关）。低于阈值的结果集判为该引擎失效并换下一个，不把垃圾结果交给模型。
   - **引擎熔断**：连续失败的引擎（如被限流的 DDG）会短期跳过，避免每次搜索都白等超时。
4. **增强型免费网页抓取（`free-fetch-pfw`）**：
   - 默认优先通过 **Jina Reader (`r.jina.ai`)** 将网页提取为干净的 Markdown 正文。
   - Jina 不可用时回退原生 HTTP，并**自动把 HTML 转纯文本**，避免把几十万字符的标签噪声交给模型。
   - **导航噪声剥离**：GitHub 等站点的导航菜单可占页面 90% 以上字符，会被剥离后只保留正文（实测 GitHub 仓库页 100000 字符 → 约 5000 字符正文）。
   - 内置 URL 校验（拒绝空 URL / 非 http(s) / 内嵌账号密码）、网络瞬时故障重试、Unicode 码点安全截断。

## 📊 与官方 DeepSeek Search/Fetch API 对比（实测）

| 指标 | 本插件 | 官方 API |
|---|---|---|
| 搜索成功率 | 10/10 | 10/10 |
| 搜索中位延迟 | ~420 ms | ~305 ms |
| 外国站占比（全部） | **0.94** | 0.90 |
| 外国站占比（纯英文查询） | **1.00** | 0.90 |
| 抓取正文噪声 | 0 标签 | 0 标签 |
| 费用 | **免费** | 5 元 / 1000 次（2026-11-01 起计费） |

结论：外国网站（github 等）检索能力**已达到并略超官方**；延迟略高于官方（官方有自建搜索引擎），但换来零成本。

## ⚠️ 上游包修复记录（本副本已修）

随包发布的 `dist/index.js` 存在以下真实缺陷，本副本均已修复：

1. **正则中的 `\b` 被写成了退格控制字符（0x08）**：Bing 的 `b_algo`/`b_caption` 匹配因此永远不命中，`web_search` 只会静默返回空结果。
2. **`www.bing.com` 对部分中文查询返回串号结果**：已按查询语言分流，中文走 `cn.bing.com`，并新增相关性闸门。
3. **英文查询返回大量中文站**：原实现只有 Bing + DDG，实测外国站占比仅 0.22；已加入 360 兜底 + 外国站优先排序，提升至 0.94~1.00。
4. **空 URL 抓取返回 Jina 自己的说明页**：已加入 URL 校验。
5. **抓取结果含大量导航噪声 / 原始 HTML**：已加入噪声剥离与 HTML→文本转换。

---

## 🚀 安装方式（任选其一）

### 方式 A：从 GitHub 一键安装（推荐）

在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天框里发送：

> 请调用 `plugin_manager` 工具（`action: install_bundle`）帮我安装这个 GitHub 插件：`github:wsjb114514/dsh-plugin-free-web`

DeepSeek Harness 会自动克隆、安装并挂载，刷新页面即可永久生效。

### 方式 B：聊天框本地安装

1. 从本仓库下载源码（`Code → Download ZIP`）并解压到固定文件夹。
2. 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天框发送（把路径换成你实际解压的路径）：
   > 请调用 `plugin_manager` 工具（`action: install_bundle`）帮我安装这个本地插件：`<你解压后的文件夹绝对路径>`

### 方式 C：双击一键安装脚本

1. 下载源码解压到固定目录。
2. **Windows 用户**：双击运行 `双击安装插件_Windows.bat`。
3. **Mac 用户**：双击运行 `双击安装插件_Mac.command`。
4. 看到“✅ 安装完成”提示后重启一次 DeepSeek Harness 即可。

---

## 📦 发布内容

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `dist/index.js` | 预编译产物，安装即用，无需 build |
| `dist/index.d.ts` | 类型声明 |
| `src/index.ts` | 源码（与 dist 同步的镜像） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle 补丁：接管 `ctx.web` 的 search/fetch provider 并禁用官方计费搜索 |
| `locale/zh.json` `locale/en.json` | 插件管理页的标题与描述 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标（原创） |

## ⚠️ 免责声明

- 本插件依赖第三方公开搜索接口（360、Bing、DuckDuckGo）与 Jina Reader、GitHub 社区镜像，这些服务的可用性与反爬策略不受本仓库控制。
- 搜索结果的准确性取决于搜索引擎；插件内置相关性闸门过滤明显无关的结果，但不保证内容完全可靠。
- 请遵守目标网站的服务条款，勿用于高频爬取。

## 📄 License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-manager

> 一个**轻量版 MCP 服务管理器**：管理本机已经接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 MCP 服务，
> 并能从 Claude Desktop / Cursor / VS Code 等客户端扫描、导入配置。
> 不做插件市场、不做远程目录、不做 OAuth 授权流——只把「本机 MCP」管好。

A lightweight MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): inspect, enable/disable, add, edit, remove,
probe, import from and export to the common `mcpServers` JSON convention. Zero npm dependencies.

## 它做什么

| 能力 | 入口 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 列出 MCP 服务 | `mcp_manager_list` / 设置页 | 来源（profile / 受管）、状态、传输、端点（脱敏）、工具数；支持关键词/状态过滤 |
| 查看详情与工具 | `mcp_manager_inspect` / 设置页展开 | 工具名 + 说明；状态区分「已连接 / 已停用 / 无工具 / 加载失败 / 未生效」 |
| 启用 / 停用 | `mcp_manager_set_enabled` / 开关 | 受管服务**持久化**；profile 静态行只改本次运行 |
| 接入新服务 | `mcp_manager_add` / 新增表单 | `streamable-http` 或 `stdio`；默认写入受管存储，重启自动恢复 |
| 编辑已有服务 | `mcp_manager_update` / 编辑表单 | URL / headers / command / args / env / cwd / 超时；密钥三态（保留/覆盖/删除） |
| 移除服务 | `mcp_manager_remove` / 删除按钮 | 受管：删记录+条目；profile：仅本次运行 |
| **握手探针** | `mcp_manager_probe` / 探针按钮 | 真实 initialize + tools/list：延迟、协议版本、工具数、结构化错误码、stderr（已脱敏） |
| **扫描本机配置** | `mcp_manager_scan` / 导入向导 | Claude Desktop / Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf / VS Code / Cline / Zed / Continue |
| **导入 `mcpServers` JSON** | `mcp_manager_import` / 粘贴 JSON | 先预览（新增/冲突）再写；冲突支持跳过/覆盖受管/自动改名；可导入为停用 |
| **导出** | `mcp_manager_export` / 导出面板 | `patch`（cordis.patch.yml，`!!js process.env.*`）/ `json`（`mcpServers`，`${ENV}`）/ `markdown` 清单 |

## 持久化怎么工作

- **profile 静态声明**（`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 行）保持只读：
  启停/编辑只影响本次运行，重启恢复；需要持久化就导出 patch。
- **本插件受管的连接**写入：
  `<DSH_HOME>/mcp-manager/connections-<profile>.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/mcp-manager/`）。
  启动时由插件自动 `ctx.loader.create/update` 成 `dsh-mcp-client` 条目，因此重启后仍在。
  - 文件权限 0600、目录 0700；原子写（tmp + rename）；每次覆盖前留一份 `.bak`；
  - 写操作串行化（同一进程内），JSON 损坏时**不覆盖原文件**、只在 UI/工具里报错。

## 安装

### 方式一：DSH 面板

设置 → 插件 → 安装，spec 填：

```
github:gainaixiaobing/dsh-mcp-manager
```

### 方式二：CLI

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:gainaixiaobing/dsh-mcp-manager
```

### 方式三：从源码手动安装（离线）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/gainaixiaobing/dsh-mcp-manager.git
cd dsh-mcp-manager
./install.sh                 # 默认桌面 profile
./install.sh ~/.dsh/profiles/web
```

装好后重启 DeepSeek Harness。Host 半区需要重启；Client 半区在有 `dsh-client-hmr` 的发行版里会热替换。

## 使用

- 设置 → **MCP 服务**：搜索/状态筛选，逐行启停、探针、编辑、删除；顶部「新增 / 导入 / 导出」；
- 对话里也可以直接说：「列出我的 MCP 服务」「探测 qcc-company 通的吗」「把 Cursor 里的 MCP 配置导入进来」
  「把当前配置导出成 patch」。

## 架构

```
┌──────────────────────── Harness 运行时 ────────────────────────┐
│  ctx.loader.entries() ──► mcp-client 条目（profile 行 + 受管行）      │
│  ctx.tools.schemas()  ──► mcp__<server>__* 工具，决定「已连接/工具数」 │
│  ctx.loader.update/create/remove ──► 启停 / 增删 / 编辑（运行时）    │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
        ▲ 10 个对话工具 mcp_manager_*
        ▲ 同源 HTTP：/mcp-manager/api/state、/mcp-manager/api/action（回环 + 同源 fence）
        │
┌───────┴──────── Web UI（设置页 settings.section）──────────────┐
│ 列表 / 状态 chips / 搜索 / 探针 / 编辑 / 导入 / 导出 / 启停      │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

代码结构（零 npm 依赖，只用 node 内建模块）：

| 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | 插件入口 + manager 门面（list/add/update/remove/setEnabled/probe/scan/import/export） |
| `lib/store.js` | 受管连接存储（0600 / 原子写 / `.bak` / 串行 mutate） |
| `lib/config.js` | record 规范化、`mcpServers` JSON 互转 |
| `lib/inventory.js` | loader 条目 + 工具注册表 → 服务清单、状态判定 |
| `lib/provision.js` | 受管 record → `dsh-mcp-client` 条目（create/update/remove） |
| `lib/probe.js` | MCP 握手探针（streamable-http / stdio、错误分类） |
| `lib/importers.js` | 8 类客户端配置扫描、JSONC 解析、mcpServers 解析 |
| `lib/export.js` | patch / mcpServers JSON / Markdown 导出 |
| `lib/sanitize.js` | 统一脱敏出口（Bearer/JWT/URL/query/KEY=value/x-api-key…） |
| `lib/tools.js` / `lib/web.js` | 对话工具与同源 HTTP API |

### 状态语义

| 状态 | 判定 |
| --- | --- |
| 已连接 | 条目已启用、已有 fiber、命名空间下有工具 |
| 无工具 | 已启用且有 fiber，但工具数为 0（服务本身不提供，或连接失败被 mcp-client 吞掉） |
| 加载失败 | 已启用但没有 fiber（apply 抛错，常见于 serverName 重复声明） |
| 未生效 | 受管记录存在，但本次启动没有成功创建 loader 条目 |
| 已停用 | 条目 `disabled: true` |

同名重复（profile 行 + 受管记录共用一个 `serverName`）会在列表里打「同名」标记；
解析时拒绝猜测，要求传条目 id；导入时按冲突策略处理。

## 安全边界

- 凭据只进受管存储（0600）或由用户自己放在 `~/.dsh/.env` 里，导出/扫描/列表**不回显**值；
- 所有对外文本（探针 error/stderr、异常）统一过 `sanitize.js`；
- HTTP API 只接受本机回环 Host、校验 Origin 同源；
- 探针 stdio 子进程会清洗父进程环境中的凭据名（KEY/PASSWORD/SECRET/TOKEN、`DSH_*`）；
- 扫描只读其它客户端配置，不写回、不修改。

## 设计参考（GitHub 调研）

实现前调研了 DSH 生态 10 个 MCP 面板与 8 个通用 MCP 管理器，取其长：

| 借鉴点 | 来源项目 |
| --- | --- |
| 自管存储 + `loader.create/update` 运行时挂载（不碰用户配置文件） | hyqhyq3/dsh-mcp-manager、null119/dsh-mcp-manage、ArvinQi/dsh-mcp |
| 受管连接持久化、编辑/删除闭环 | 同上 + functy23/dsh-mcp-studio |
| 导入前 plan（新增/冲突）+ 冲突策略 | modelcontextprotocol/inspector（planImport） |
| `mcpServers` 多形态解析、JSONC、跨客户端互操作 | milisp/mcp-linker、ravitemer/mcphub.nvim |
| 探针结构化诊断（延迟/协议/错误码/stderr） | PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel、milisp/mcp-linker |
| 密钥三态语义（缺省=保留 / null=删除 / 值=覆盖） | Fishquito7/dsh-skill-mcp-panel |
| 统一脱敏出口 | PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel |
| 状态 chips、工具名搜索、诊断复制 | Js2Hou/dsh-mcp-manager、hyqhyq3/dsh-mcp-manager |

> 只借鉴设计思路，未复制代码；所有实现为本仓库独立编写。

## 开发与测试

```bash
node --check index.js && node --check client.js
node --test test/host.test.mjs    # 22 个：存储/清单/导入导出/探针/脱敏/schema
node --test test/client.test.mjs  # 7 个：模块注册、槽位、渲染、启停、探针、面板
npm test                          # 两套一起跑
```

端到端验证方式见 [`test/README.md`](test/README.md)。GitHub Actions 在 Node 20/22/24 上跑同一套测试。

## 卸载

```bash
./uninstall.sh                    # 桌面 profile
./uninstall.sh ~/.dsh/profiles/web
```

通过面板/CLI 安装的，直接在面板里停用/卸载。受管存储文件不会被自动删除（如需清理由你手动删）。

## 限制

- 状态里的「已连接」= 工具已注册，不代表服务端业务可用；探针才是真实握手（但不会调用业务工具）；
- 探针 tools/list 只取第一页（不翻 cursor），工具数特别多的服务可能少算；
- 不做 OAuth 授权流：需要 OAuth 的服务请自行获取 token 后用 `headers`/`env` 传入；
- 受管存储是明文 JSON（0600 权限），与 `~/.dsh/.env` 同级信任模型；不要把它提交进 git；
- 不做 profile 文件写入器：持久化统一走「导出 patch + 手动合并」，避免插件替用户改配置。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 开窍 · AI 私人老师：给 DeepSeek Harness 装一位私人老师，为你定制课程，在手写黑板上边写边讲。
plugins.readme_text:
# 开窍 · AI 私人老师 **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md) **给 DeepSeek Harness 装一位私人老师：说出你想弄懂的东西，它先了解你，再为你做一门课，在手写黑板上边写边讲。** [![CI](https://github.com/BaronCyrus/dsh-aha-tutor/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/BaronCyrus/dsh-aha-tutor/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-aha-tutor?logo=npm&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-aha-tutor) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-111111.svg)](LICENSE) [能做什么](#能做什么) · [安装](#安装) · [三分钟上手](#三分钟上手) · [界面预览](#界面预览) · [使用指南](docs/guide.zh-CN.md) · [隐私](#隐私与数据) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [支持作者](#支持作者)

## 能做什么 | 能力 | 体验 | | --- | --- | | **为你定制一门课** | 说一句想学什么，或者丢进一本教材。老师先用几道选择题了解你的基础、目标和时间，再给出「单元 → 章 → 讲」的课程蓝图。你可以直接改，也可以用一句话让它改，确认后生成练习和实战项目 | | **手写黑板课堂** | 老师一边讲（语音 + 字幕），一边在黑板上逐字写下要点、公式、示意图和图表，需要时还会放一段小动画；随时暂停、回放、变速 | | **随堂小测与自适应** | 讲到关键处会停下来考你一题，并问你「有多确定」。猜对、犹豫、自信地答错，会被区别对待；学完一讲后，薄弱的知识点会自动加一节巩固课 | | **举手提问、换个讲法** | 没听懂就举手，老师在黑板上专门回答你，讲完回到原来的进度；也可以让它用打比方、画图、举例、讲简单点或讲深一点的方式重讲这一步 | | **练习、闪卡与复习** | 每讲都有练习，简答题由 AI 批改；闪卡和知识点按间隔重复安排复习，学习计划会自动给复习留出时间 | | **资料变课程** | 支持 PDF、Word、PPT、Markdown、网页链接和图片（图片需要支持识图的模型）。讲课和速查表会引用原文页码；长文档可以一键「消化」成结构、论点和术语表 | | **速查表、笔记、测验** | 按主题整理的可打印速查表（列数、字号、高亮可调），以及笔记、闪卡组和测验 | | **讲解短片 + 导出视频** | 输入一个主题或网址，得到一段约两分钟的白板讲解；任何一讲都能导出成带板书动画、字幕和水印的视频，适合分享 | | **实战项目** | 代码类项目一键生成项目文件夹和起始文件，并在 DSH 里打开一个会话，让编程 Agent 陪你做；做完回来提交，老师按评分标准逐项点评 | | **学习计划与画像** | 按每周时间、学习日和截止日期自动排课并提示进度风险；老师会记住你的背景和薄弱点，你可以随时查看、修改或清空 | | **对话里也能用** | 新增「开窍 · AI 私人老师」会话预设：在 DSH 对话中，老师可以上白板讲解、出互动小测、帮你建课、做速查表 | 不想先花 token？首页自带两门示例课（「简谐运动」「贝叶斯思维」），打开就能体验完整的黑板课堂。 ## 安装 先准备好 **DeepSeek Harness** 桌面版（0.2.1 及以上的 0.2.x 版本），并在 DSH 里配置好至少一个可用的模型。尚未安装 DSH，可查看 [DSH 官方说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#run)。 1. 打开桌面应用的**插件**页，点击**添加插件**，在**包名或地址**中填入： ```text dsh-aha-tutor ``` 安装源选择**官方源**，点击**安装**。新版本刚发布的 24 小时内，DSH 的 pnpm 会因为发布冷却期暂缓安装，这时请填入精确版本，例如 `dsh-aha-tutor@1.0.0`。 2. **完全退出并重新打开** DSH 桌面应用。只刷新页面不会加载 Host 端的新插件。 3. 左侧栏出现 **「开窍 · AI 私人老师」**，点开即可使用。
离线安装 / 自建 profile - 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/BaronCyrus/dsh-aha-tutor/releases/latest) 下载 `dsh-aha-tutor-<版本>.tgz`，在**包名或地址**中填入它的绝对路径。 - 自建 profile 可以用 `dsh plugin --profile add dsh-aha-tutor@<版本>`。不要对 `desktop` profile 使用这条命令，桌面版请走插件页。
## 三分钟上手 1. **说出目标**：在首页输入「三周内搞懂线性代数里的特征值」，或附上一份讲义，点**开始**。 2. **回答几个问题**：选一选你的基础、目的和节奏，点**生成课程蓝图**。不满意就直接改，或者写一句「多加一些编程练习」。 3. **确认开课**：点**确认，生成整门课**，然后在课程页点**继续学习**，老师就会在黑板上开讲。 想快速问一个概念、解一道题、看一张图？用首页的「讲个概念」「陪我解题」「画出来看看」，不用建课。 ## 界面预览 | 首页 | 黑板课堂 | | --- | --- | | | | | **随堂小测** | **导出的讲解视频** | | | | ## 语音 | 方式 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **系统语音（默认，免费）** | 使用 macOS / Windows 自带的音色，可在设置中挑选；系统没有中文音色时会给出提示 | | **云端语音（可选）** | 支持 OpenAI 兼容接口（含硅基流动等）、火山引擎（豆包语音）、MiniMax、Azure 语音。密钥保存在 DSH 的凭据库中，只在 Host 端使用，不会传给浏览器；合成过的语音会缓存在本机，重播不再计费 | 导出视频时，只有云端语音能被录进视频；用系统语音导出的视频带字幕、没有声音。黑板上的小动画在视频里以一帧静态画面出现。 ## 模型 默认使用你在 DSH 里设置的默认模型。在 **开窍 → 设置** 里，可以分别为「出课与讲课」和「批改与问答」指定模型，例如出课用更强的模型、批改用更快的模型。 插件不会自动切换到其它付费模型，也不会在后台批量消耗额度：课程结构在你确认时生成，每一讲的板书在你打开时才生成（同时预备下一讲）。使用订阅类模型时，请遵守对应服务的使用条款。 ## 隐私与数据 - 课程、进度、资料、画像和学习计划都保存在本机：`$DSH_HOME/aha-tutor/`（默认 `~/.dsh/aha-tutor/`，Windows 为 `C:\Users\<用户名>\.dsh\aha-tutor\`）。 - 实战项目的文件夹在 `~/AhaTutor/projects/` 下，插件不会覆盖你已经改过的文件。 - 发给模型的内容只有完成当前任务所需的部分：你的问题、课程结构、相关的资料片段，以及简短的学习画像。 - 网页导入只抓取公开地址，不访问本机或局域网地址。 - 模型生成的示意图会经过白名单过滤；动画运行在无网络权限的沙箱里。 详见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。 ## 更新与卸载 **开窍 → 设置 → 插件版本**可以检查更新，并用 DSH 自带的 pnpm 安装精确的新版本。新版本发布不满 24 小时时会显示「待更新」和可以更新的时间，这是 DSH 的供应链安全策略，不是失败。更新后需要完全退出并重新打开 DSH。 在桌面应用的**插件**页可以停用或卸载插件。卸载不会删除 `~/.dsh/aha-tutor/` 里的学习数据；不再需要时可以手动删除这个文件夹。 ## 常见问题 **老师没有声音？** 打开 **开窍 → 设置 → 语音讲解**，点**试听**。没有中文音色时，可在系统设置里安装中文语音，或改用云端语音。 **生成失败或结果不理想？** 点**重试**，或在设置里为「出课与讲课」换一个更强的模型。 **PDF 里读不出文字？** 扫描版 PDF 没有文字层，可以截图后以图片上传（需要支持识图的模型）。 **会话里怎么用老师？** 新建会话时，在预设里选择 **「开窍 · AI 私人老师」**。 ## 开发 ```bash pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run check ``` `pnpm run check` 会依次运行全部测试、构建 Host 与浏览器端的包，并在 `.artifacts/` 下打出 tgz。本地开发时，可在 DSH 插件页填入仓库的绝对路径，以 `link:` 方式安装。改动 Host 代码后，需要重启 DSH 才能生效。仓库结构与约定见 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。 ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE) © BaronCyrus。第三方组件的许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 「开窍 / Aha Tutor」是独立的开源项目，与 DeepSeek 或其他任何学习产品均无隶属关系。 ## 支持作者 开窍免费开源，赞赏全凭心意。如果它帮你弄懂了某个卡了很久的知识点，欢迎扫码支持，让小窍继续长大。

微信赞赏
支付宝

plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. plugins.description: DSH community plugin: ask any set of models to draw a pelican riding a bicycle on a schedule, then lay every drawing out on a read-only board. No scoring — the pictures are the result. Pausable, with a settable interval.
plugins.readme_text:
# @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

A DeepSeek Harness **community plugin** that runs a long-term
**model-quality probe** (降智监测) on a schedule, across **any number of
models**:

- **Pick your models** — the gear in the panel's top-right corner lists every model the
  configured providers report (live `/models` discovery, merged with the models
  in your DSH profile) and probes a multi-selected set, each model through its
  own provider and API key.
- **Scheduled drawing** — every 30 minutes (configurable) each selected model is
  asked to draw a *pelican riding a bicycle* as a single-file HTML page with an
  inline SVG.
- **No skills, no tools** — each run is a bare `chat/completions` request with
  no tool definitions and no agent loop, so the result measures the model
  alone, never your local skills.
- **Everything flat, nothing to click** — the main board is read-only: one band
  per model, its status and figures on the left (when its newest drawing landed,
  runs, average duration, how many came back without a drawing, and the failure
  reason) and every drawing it ever made on the right, all laid out at once —
  nothing collapsed, filtered, or hidden behind a click.
- **Run state in the header** — while probing: “n/m done”, which models are in
  flight, how long the slowest has waited (m:ss) and the timeout cap (m:ss), so a
  slow model and a stuck one are told apart at a glance.
- **One gear button** — the panel's own top-right corner opens a settings sheet:
  pick models, probe now, open one drawing's original page. The board below stays
  pure viewing, so nothing has to be clicked to be read.
- **Stop it, retune it** — that same sheet can **pause / resume automatic
  probing**, change the **interval** (1–1440 minutes), and **stop the pass that is
  running right now**: requests in flight are aborted, models that had not started
  are skipped without a request being sent. Pausing is written to
  `settings.json` immediately and survives a restart, so a plugin you only probe
  by hand never costs a token on its own.
- **Bounded history** — keeps the newest N drawings (12 by default), pruning
  older ones automatically. Same prompt, same model, over days: degradation
  shows up as worse structure, refusals (saved and badged 「未检出 SVG」), or
  latency growth.

## Install

From this GitHub repository (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/mi-lu-uncle/dsh-pelican-watch.git
```

Or from a local path or tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pelican-watch
```

Note: `link:`-installed plugins are not watched by HMR, so editing
`lib/index.js` or `lib/client.js` requires an app restart to take effect.

## Choosing models

The gear in the panel's top-right corner opens the settings sheet: every provider found in your DSH profiles, with
the models it serves (its own `/models` endpoint, merged with whatever the
profile already lists). Tick any number of models and **Save models** — from the next
cycle on each selected model draws its own picture and gets its own band on the
board.

That selection lives in `dir/settings.json` and is what the scheduler uses;
`config.model` / `config.targets` only seed the first run. The same file holds
two knobs that decide what you spend, both changeable from the panel's gear
without touching any config file:

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoEnabled` | `true` | Off disarms the timer at once (`nextRunAt` goes empty); only the manual “probe now” then spends anything, and the choice survives a restart. |
| `intervalMinutes` | follows `config.intervalMinutes` (30) | Changing it in the panel re-arms the countdown immediately — no restart. |
`config.model` / `config.targets` only seed the very first run. At most 12
models are probed per cycle — `concurrency` of them at the same time (3 by
default), one drawing each.

## Speed and timeouts

- **Models run in parallel** (3 at a time by default), so one slow model no
  longer delays the others: every drawing is written to disk the moment it
  arrives and shows up in the panel within seconds.
- **Each request has its own timeout** (`timeoutSeconds`, default 180). A model
  that exceeds it is reported as `超过 N 秒没有返回` on its own band instead of
  hanging the whole pass. Reasoning models can genuinely be slow — measured
  against one provider: `qwen3.7-max` ~52s, `deepseek-flash` ~121s (15k of those
  completion tokens were reasoning), while `glm-5.3-flash` sometimes exceeded
  4 minutes.
- **A timeout or HTTP error is not a drawing**: nothing is saved and it does not
  count as a drawing, because that is an infrastructure fact rather than model
  behaviour. A model that *answers* without an SVG (a refusal) is saved and
  marked `没出图` — that is the signal worth looking at.
- `maxTokens` is not sent by default: reasoning models spend tens of thousands of
  completion tokens before they draw, and a tight ceiling would truncate the SVG
  instead of speeding anything up.

## Configuration

Defaults match the usual profile setup; override any of them on a
`pelican-watch` row in your profile patch (`cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: pelican-watch
  config:
    model: glm-5.3-flash                 # seed model (the panel's selection wins)
    baseURL: https://taotoken.net/api/v1 # OpenAI-compatible endpoint
    apiKeyEnv: TAOTOKEN_API_KEY          # env var holding the API key…
    # apiKey: sk-…                       # …or put the key here directly
    # targets:                           # optional: seed several models at once
    #   - { provider: taotoken, baseURL: https://taotoken.net/api/v1, apiKeyEnv: TAOTOKEN_API_KEY, model: glm-5.3-flash }
    intervalMinutes: 30                  # drawing cadence
    maxImages: 12                        # history depth (per model ≈6h at 30min)
    timeoutSeconds: 180                  # per-request ceiling; raise it for slow models
    concurrency: 3                       # how many models are probed at once
    # maxTokens: 8192                    # optional; unset by default (see below)
    dir: ~/.dsh/pelican-watch            # where drawings are saved
    runOnStart: true                     # draw once ~8s after boot
    # temperature: 0.7                   # optional; omitted by default
    # prompt: …                          # only if you must change the benchmark
```

The benchmark prompt is deliberately fixed — changing it makes the history
incomparable, so treat `prompt` as a last resort.

## API key

The key is resolved at call time, in this order:

1. a literal `apiKey` in config;
2. `process.env[apiKeyEnv]` (default `TAOTOKEN_API_KEY`);
3. the same name in DSH's own credential store — `refs:` in
   `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (override the path with `credentialsFile`).

Step 3 is why a DSH-configured provider key works with no extra setup: the
desktop app is launched from Finder/Dock and therefore does **not** inherit
environment variables exported in a shell, while `refs:` already holds the key
under the provider's `apiKeyEnv` name.

With none of the three the run is skipped and the panel shows the reason
(`缺少 API Key：…`) — set any one of them and the next scheduled run proceeds.

## Display only — no scoring

This plugin **does not score anything**. It does two things: it asks every model
the same drawing prompt on a schedule, and it lays the drawings out as they are.

Earlier versions computed a 0-100 "structural score" offline (is there an SVG, two
wheels, a frame, wings…). That has been removed on request: such a number can
only approximate “did these elements appear”, and it lends a false precision.
The judgement is left to whoever looks at the pictures (or to a vision model):
**same prompt, same model, over consecutive days — the drawings themselves are
the finding**, and no digit has to stand in for them.

The numbers that remain on the board are not grades, just facts: how many runs,
average duration, when the newest drawing landed, and how many runs came back
without a drawing. `没有出图` means the request returned but carried no usable

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: Fork of jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher updated for DSH 0.2.1: switch the current session agent preset (mode) at any time, plus repair for sessions whose preset was deleted.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-preset-switcher > [English](#english) | **中文** > **Fork 说明**：上游 `jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher` 最后提交是 2026-08-17，未适配 > DSH 0.2.1。该版本移除了宿主 `webRuntime` 服务（现在提供 `webApp`），而上游插件 > `inject: ['webServer', 'webRuntime']` 因此永远不挂载、`/preset-switch/api` 404， > 前端下拉菜单随之失效。本 fork 只做兼容修复（见 CHANGELOG.md），功能与上游一致。 > 已在 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2** 上验证：插件正常挂载，`list` / `switch` / `repair` 三个方法 > 均按预期返回。安装方式见下方「安装 / 更新」，一条 `dsh plugin add` 即可。 --- ## 概述 DSH Web 插件：在**任何时候**切换当前会话的代理预设（模式），包括对话已经开始之后 — 原生 UI 不允许这样做（"已开始的对话的代理预设已固定"）。 ### 核心功能 - **顶部下拉菜单**：会话标题操作栏中的「当前模式 ▾」按钮，列出所有预设（如 `standard`=标准模式、`code`=PTC 模式、`minimal`=极简模式、`cordis`=创造模式），用 ✓ 标记当前预设，点击即切换。 - **失效预设修复**：如果会话记录的预设已被删除（自定义预设被移除），恢复将失败导致会话不可用。下拉菜单中的「修复失效模式会话」操作（及 `repair` API）会扫描所有会话日志并重写失效引用 — 最后一个 `agent-preset/selected` 事件，否则是标题 — 重置为默认预设，操作前自动备份日志并跳过活跃会话。切换未加载的会话时若引用失效也会自动修复。 - **受控路由**：`POST /preset-switch/api`，参数 `{ method: 'list' | 'switch' | 'repair', sessionId, presetId, target? }`（回环/可信主机限制，与 dsh-sounds 相同）。 ### 工作原理 原生 API（`agentPresets.select`）通过空白会话检查来保护切换操作。本插件底层调用同一原子原语 — `agentPresets.recompose(agent.ctx, presetId)` — 将代理的作用域重新链接到目标预设的常驻挂载点。新组合在链接移动前确保完成，因此损坏的预设不会影响会话。成功后插件追加与代理记录相同的 `agent-preset/selected` 会话事件，使投影和标题标签同步更新。 **限制**：仅已加载的活跃会话可切换；子代理拥有的会话将被拒绝；新的工具集/人设从下一个模型步骤生效。 ## 安装 / 更新 需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2（或同代 0.2.x）。插件是纯 JavaScript，没有构建步骤，装完即用。 ```powershell # 方式一（推荐）：直接从 GitHub 仓库安装 dsh plugin --profile web add github:neutronslime/dsh-preset-switcher-fork # 方式二：克隆到你自己选的目录，再从该目录安装（不依赖作者机器上的任何路径） git clone https://github.com/neutronslime/dsh-preset-switcher-fork.git dsh plugin --profile web add .\dsh-preset-switcher-fork ``` 安装或升级后重启 `dsh web`（profile 启动时会合并 `cordis.patch.yml`），刷新页面， 会话标题栏右侧就会出现「当前模式 ▾」按钮。 `dsh plugin` 把参数转交给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，不需要全局 npm；想自己检查打包内容， `npm pack --dry-run` 也可以（node 20.17+ 或 22.9+ 即可，npm 11 实测无碍）。 ## 文件结构 | 文件 | 说明 | |------|------| | `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle 补丁：将插件行插入 profile 的 cordis 树（`dsh.bundle.patch`） | | `lib/index.js` | 服务端：受控 `/preset-switch/api` 路由（list / switch / repair）及会话日志修复逻辑 | | `lib/client.js` | 浏览器端：顶部下拉菜单（ClientModuleSystem bundle，React 通过 module-table externals） | | `scripts/` | `restart-web.ps1`（通用版重启+探测，路径自动推导）、`inspect-session.mjs` / `repair-session.mjs`（独立日志工具） | ## 许可证 MIT --- # dsh-preset-switcher > **English** | [中文](#概述) > **Fork note**: upstream `jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher` was last committed on 2026-08-17 and does not run on DSH 0.2.1: that release dropped the host `webRuntime` service (the web runtime now provides `webApp`), so the upstream `inject: ['webServer', 'webRuntime']` never mounts, `/preset-switch/api` answers 404, and the header dropdown is dead. This fork is the compatibility fix only (see CHANGELOG.md) — same features as upstream. Verified on **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**: the plugin mounts and `list` / `switch` / `repair` all answer as expected. Install is a single `dsh plugin add`; see "Install / update" below. --- ## Overview DSH web plugin: switch the current session's agent preset (mode) at **any time**, including after the conversation has already started — the stock UI refuses that ("a started conversation's agent preset is fixed"). ### Features - **Header dropdown**: a "当前模式 ▾" button in the session header action row lists every preset (e.g. `standard`=标准模式, `code`=PTC 模式, `minimal`=极简模式, `cordis`=创造模式), marks the session's current one with ✓, and switches on click. - **Stale-preset repair**: if a session's recorded preset was deleted (a custom preset removed), resume fails and the session becomes unusable. The dropdown's "修复失效模式会话" action (and `repair` API) scans every session log and rewrites stale references — the last `agent-preset/selected` event, else the header — to the default preset, backing up the log first and skipping live sessions. Switching a not-loaded session whose reference is stale auto-repairs it too. - **Fenced route**: `POST /preset-switch/api` with `{ method: 'list' | 'switch' | 'repair', sessionId, presetId, target? }` (loopback/trusted-host fence, same as dsh-sounds). ### How it works The stock API (`agentPresets.select`) guards its swap with a blank-session check. This plugin calls the same atomic primitive underneath — `agentPresets.recompose(agent.ctx, presetId)` — which re-links the agent's scope to the target preset's standing mount. The new composition is ensured before the link moves, so a broken preset leaves the session untouched. On success the plugin appends the same `agent-preset/selected` session event the proxy records, so projections and the header label follow. Limits: only live (currently loaded) sessions can switch; subagent-owned sessions are refused; the new toolset/persona applies from the next model step. ## Install / update Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (or another 0.2.x build). The plugin is plain JavaScript — there is no build step. ```powershell # Option 1 (recommended): install straight from the GitHub repository dsh plugin --profile web add github:neutronslime/dsh-preset-switcher-fork # Option 2: clone into a directory of your choosing, then install from it git clone https://github.com/neutronslime/dsh-preset-switcher-fork.git dsh plugin --profile web add .\dsh-preset-switcher-fork ``` Restart `dsh web` after installing or upgrading (the profile boot merges `cordis.patch.yml`), reload the page, and the "当前模式 ▾" button appears in the session header. `dsh plugin` forwards to the pnpm inside the profile directory, so no global npm is needed; `npm pack --dry-run` works too if you want to inspect the tarball (node 20.17+ or 22.9+; npm 11 is fine). ## Layout | File | Description | |------|-------------| | `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch: inserts the plugin row into the profile's cordis tree (`dsh.bundle.patch`). | | `lib/index.js` | Host half: the fenced `/preset-switch/api` routes (list / switch / repair) and the session-log repair logic. | | `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the header dropdown (ClientModuleSystem bundle, React via module-table externals). | | `scripts/` | `restart-web.ps1` (port-agnostic restart + probe; all paths derived at runtime), `inspect-session.mjs` / `repair-session.mjs` (standalone log tools). | ## License MIT

plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件与设置备份 / 跨机同步工具：一键把全部插件、配置和插件数据打包成可移植 .zip，在新电脑上先预览再批量还原。5 个 agent 工具 + 零依赖独立 CLI；凭据默认排除、可选 AES-256-GCM 加密导出；还原默认只预览，应用前自动生成还原点。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-config-sync

把本机 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的**全部插件与设置**备份成一个可移植的 `.zip`，再批量同步到下一台电脑。

> 📖 **日常操作请看 [使用说明.md](使用说明.md)**——按"照着做"的口径编写，含换电脑完整流程、回退步骤和常见问题。本文档偏设计与实现。

## 它解决什么问题

换电脑时，DSH 的环境散落在很多地方：profile 里装了哪些插件、每个插件的版本、`cordis.patch.yml` 里的配置覆盖、插件自己写的数据、全局工作区设置……手工搬极易漏项，而**漏掉一处就可能让新电脑上的 DSH 起不来**。

这个插件把这些收拢成一个文件，并保证还原过程可预览、可回退。

## 核心设计取舍

| 决策 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| **不备份 `node_modules`** | 插件本体有几百 MB，且完全可由 `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml` 复现。归档只记录版本，还原时重装，新电脑得到的是干净正确的依赖树。 |
| **不备份运行时/Electron/日志/缓存** | 这些属于机器而非用户，是可重建的。把 Windows 运行时拷到新装环境正是"还原把好环境弄坏"的典型原因。 |
| **凭据默认不含，且永不明文** | `.credentials.yaml` 和 `workbuddy-vault/` 里是 API key 和登录 token。归档是会被拷到 U 盘和网盘的文件，**默认排除**；显式要求时用 AES-256-GCM 加密成独立成员。 |
| **还原默认只预览** | 写入前必须先看到"会改哪些文件、会增删哪些插件"。加 `apply: true` 才真正执行。 |
| **应用前自动做还原点** | 每次写入前把当前 profile 配置快照到带时间戳的目录，误操作可退回。 |
| **目标有额外插件时拒绝执行** | 避免"同步一次，把本机独有的插件配置弄丢"。需显式 `overwritePlugins: true`。 |

## 安装

插件目录：`D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync`

```powershell
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync
```

装完需要**重启 DSH** 才会注册工具。

> 该命令要写 `C:\Users\ThinkPad\.dsh\profiles\desktop`（在工作区之外），在受限沙箱下会报 EPERM，需要一次完全权限。

## 用法

### 在 DSH 会话里（推荐）

装好后直接对 agent 说，例如：

- 「看看我这台电脑现在有哪些插件和设置」→ `dsh_config_status`
- 「把插件和设置备份出来」→ `backup_dsh_config`
- 「把这个备份还原到新电脑」→ `restore_dsh_config`

五个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `dsh_config_status` | 看现状：装了哪些插件、各类设置文件数量、备份会包含什么 |
| `backup_dsh_config` | 生成备份归档（支持 `dryRun` 预览） |
| `restore_dsh_config` | 预览/应用还原 |
| `verify_dsh_config` | 校验归档完整性（逐个成员核对 sha256） |
| `list_dsh_backups` | 列出已有归档 |

### 命令行（DSH 起不来时用这个）

```powershell
$cli = "D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"   # 仅用于装插件
node D:\Dsh\Sync\dsh-config-sync\bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs <命令>
```

```powershell
# 看现状
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs status

# 备份（默认不含凭据和会话）
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\backup\dsh.zip

# 备份并加密包含登录凭据
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\backup\dsh.zip `
     --categories profile-config,home-config,plugin-state,credentials --password 你的口令

# 校验
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs verify --input D:\backup\dsh.zip

# 还原：默认只预览
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\backup\dsh.zip --profile desktop

# 确认后真正写入
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\backup\dsh.zip --profile desktop --apply
```

## 换电脑的完整流程

**旧电脑**

```powershell
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs backup --output D:\dsh-backup.zip
```

**新电脑**（先装好 DSH 本体）

```powershell
# 1. 校验归档，确认传输没损坏
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs verify --input D:\dsh-backup.zip

# 2. 预览：看清楚会写入什么、插件增删情况
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\dsh-backup.zip --profile desktop

# 3. 应用
node bin\dsh-config-sync.mjs restore --input D:\dsh-backup.zip --profile desktop --apply
```

**4. 安装插件**（归档不含 `node_modules`，第 3 步会打印完整命令）

```powershell
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-pet@0.3.7
D:\Dsh\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mnemon@0.5.29
# …按第 3 步输出的清单逐个装
```

**5. 重启 DSH。**

## 备份类别

| 类别 | 默认 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `profile-config` | ✅ | `package.json`、`pnpm-lock.yaml`、`cordis.yml`、`cordis.patch.yml` 等 |
| `home-config` | ✅ | `storages/workspace.json`、`telemetry/` 等全局设置 |
| `plugin-state` | ✅ | 各插件在 `DSH_HOME` 下的状态目录 |
| `credentials` | ❌ | 登录凭据，需 `password`，AES-256-GCM 加密 |
| `sessions` | ❌ | 会话记录，体积大 |

## 安全说明

- 明文凭据**从不**进入归档。代码里有一条独立防线：任何成员名命中凭据模式都会直接报错中止，而不是默默写进去。
- `workbuddy-vault/` 存的是明文 token，它在 `plugin-state` 里会被自动排除并给出提示——这是实测发现的真实风险点。
- 加密用 scrypt（N=2¹⁵）派生密钥 + AES-256-GCM，口令错误或归档被篡改都会解密失败，不会还原出似是而非的内容。
- **忘记口令 = 凭据无法恢复**，需要在新电脑重新登录。

## 测试

```powershell
node --test test/          # 或直接：node test/sync.test.mjs
```

覆盖 ZIP 往返与损坏检测、加密往返与错误口令、清单排除规则、凭据隔离、预览不落盘、还原点、篡改检测和 CLI。

> 在受限沙箱里，涉及子进程的 4 个 CLI 用例会因 `spawn EPERM` 跳过——那是沙箱禁止管道 stdio，不是插件缺陷。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-config-sync/
├── bin/dsh-config-sync.mjs   # 独立 CLI（DSH 起不来时的救援通道）
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js              # 插件入口，注册 5 个工具
│   ├── inventory.js          # 决定备份什么（核心策略所在）
│   ├── archive.js            # 备份 / 预览 / 还原 / 校验
│   ├── crypto.js             # 口令加密
│   └── zip.js                # 零依赖 ZIP 读写
├── test/sync.test.mjs
└── cordis.patch.yml
```

零运行时依赖：ZIP 和加密都用 Node 内置模块实现，避免在"正在修环境"的机器上还要先装依赖。

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Live per-session cost badge for DeepSeek Harness (top-right), with peak/off-peak (time-of-day) pricing.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-cost-meter

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-cost-meter)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-cost-meter)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2ea44f)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that puts a **live cost badge in the conversation header (top-right)** and prices every request with **peak / off-peak (time-of-day) tiers**.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Session title                                [¥0.0042]      │   ← badge here
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  … conversation …                                            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Features

- **Live** — the badge updates as the host reports provider usage; no polling, no timers.
- **Historically correct** — each request is priced by its **own wall-clock timestamp**, so a session that spans peak and off-peak stays accurate even if the page sits open overnight.
- **Weekday-aware peak tiers** — DeepSeek bills peak only **Monday–Friday**; weekends are off-peak all day. The schedule is configurable (windows, weekdays, multiplier, time zone).
- **Silent price sync** — a bundled price catalog plus an out-of-band remote catalog refreshed on an interval. Push a new `catalog/prices.json` and every installed copy picks it up **without a plugin release**; a failed refresh keeps the last good rates.
- **Explicit peak/off-peak rates** — models may carry an explicit discounted pair (`cacheMiss` + `cacheMissOffPeak`), not just a multiplier.
- **Route-aware matching** — `provider/model`, `provider/*`, `*`-model wildcards, and case/space/punctuation-insensitive model ids.
- **Never fakes a number** — an unpriced route renders `未配置` (`unpriced`) instead of a made-up fallback rate.

## Install

### From npm (recommended)

```cmd
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-cost-meter
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` activates it as a profile layer automatically — no manual `cordis.patch.yml` row is required.

### From a local checkout

```cmd
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:E:/path/to/dsh-plugin-cost-meter"
```

`link:` keeps the checkout live, so edits apply after a `dsh web` restart without reinstalling.

Restart the server afterwards:

```cmd
dsh web
```

## Configure

The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row with defaults. Override it by adding a `cost-meter` row with the same `id` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: cost-meter
      name: dsh-plugin-cost-meter
      config:
        currency: CNY                 # display currency; empty = catalog currency
        fx:
          cnyPerUsd: 7.1              # used when the catalog is USD and you display CNY
        catalogUrl: ""                # "" = this package's own catalog (derived from repository)
        refreshMinutes: 360           # silent refresh interval; 0 disables it
        pricingTimeoutMs: 4000
        pricingUrl: ""                # optional legacy { models, default } document
        models:                       # manual overrides (highest priority, display currency)
          deepseek-official/deepseek-flash:
            inputPerM: 1.06           # off-peak base
            cacheReadPerM: 0.021
            cacheWritePerM: 1.06
            outputPerM: 4.26
        default:                      # optional fallback; omit to report unknown routes as unpriced
          inputPerM: 1
          outputPerM: 4
        peak:
          enabled: true
          multiplier: 2               # used only when a rate has no explicit off-peak value
          timezoneOffsetMinutes: 480  # UTC+8
          days: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]       # ISO weekdays; weekends are off-peak
          windows: [[9, 12], [14, 18]]
```

Two rate styles are accepted everywhere:

- **Catalog style** (peak base + optional off-peak): `cacheMiss`, `cacheHit`, `cacheWrite`, `output`, and `cacheMissOffPeak`, `cacheHitOffPeak`, `cacheWriteOffPeak`, `outputOffPeak`.
- **Legacy style** (off-peak base): `inputPerM`, `cacheReadPerM`, `cacheWritePerM`, `outputPerM` (with optional `*Peak` fields).

## Automatic price updates

Prices resolve in this order (highest wins):

1. `config.models` / `config.default`
2. `config.pricingUrl` (legacy document)
3. the **remote catalog** at `config.catalogUrl` — default: this package's own `catalog/prices.json` on GitHub, derived from `package.json.repository`
4. the **bundled** `catalog/prices.json` (offline fallback)

A timer re-reads the remote catalog and `pricingUrl` every `refreshMinutes` (default 6 hours) and swaps the live table in place:

- a failed refresh **keeps the last successful data**;
- a source that never loaded does not clear anything;
- a price change applies to the whole session on the **next event**, and immediately on a page reload.

This makes the catalog the single place to maintain rates: **edit and push `catalog/prices.json`, and installed copies update themselves** — no new plugin release. Forks get their own update channel automatically because the default URL is derived from `package.json.repository`.

To point at a private mirror or a local file, set `catalogUrl` (`https://…`, a path, or `file:///…`). Set it to `""` to disable remote syncing.

## Peak / off-peak

- Tiering uses the **request's own `event.time`**, never "now".
- Peak applies only on the configured weekdays (`days`, default Monday–Friday); weekends are off-peak all day.
- The schedule comes from the catalog's `peakSchedule` (time zone, days, windows, off-peak ratio) and can be overridden field by field in `config.peak`.
- `peak.enabled: false` bills one flat rate; `peak.timezoneOffsetMinutes` shifts the wall clock for the window check.

The hover tooltip shows the current tier, the multiplier, the route, and the token breakdown.

## Pricing model

```
cost = Σ_routes [ cost_off(route) + cost_peak(route) ]

cost_tier(route) = (uncachedInput × miss
                  + cacheRead     × hit
                  + cacheWrite    × write
                  + output        × out) / 1_000_000
```

Totals are accumulated per `{ provider, model }` route and per tier, so switching models mid-session keeps each route on its own price. A repeated usage sample for the same `(turn, step)` replaces the earlier one instead of double-counting.

## Compatibility

| Surface | DSH ≤ 0.1.0-rc.6 | DSH ≥ 0.1.5 |
|---|---|---|
| Projection contract | `schema` + `view` | `stateSchema` + `wire: { viewSchema, view }` |
| Client deps | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session` |
| Compatibility gate | — | `engines.dsh` / `peerDependencies` must satisfy the running version |

The badge uses the additive `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot; `…header.corner` is a `single` slot already occupied by a shipped plugin.

## Development

```cmd
npm install
npm test
```

`test/contract.test.mjs` covers the projection contract, weekday peak, catalog parsing, explicit dual rates, currency conversion, normalization/wildcards, unpriced routes, and manual overrides. It runs offline (`catalogUrl: ""`).

## Notes

- Costs are **estimates**: they depend on the provider-reported `usage` and on the price table.
- The badge is **per session**; it does not aggregate sub-sessions or the whole account.
- The bundled catalog is a dated snapshot — verify it against the [official pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) and update `catalog/prices.json` when rates change.
- The plugin is a Web surface plugin; compositions without `sessionProjections` (e.g. headless) skip registration.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect.
